Title: 365 Nights with the Mafia King
Tags: Love Triangle; Age Gap; Sweet Love; Forbidden Love
Synopsis: On the night Ella Connor comes of age, the newly crowned matriarch of the Connor family receives a confession from the man she's secretly loved for five years: Dante De Luca. The Godfather of the Luca family, her legal guardian, and her so-called "uncle".  One kiss is all it takes for Ella to see the truth—this ruthless, powerful man has eyes for no one but her.  But their rival Marco smells blood. "Once I'm sure she's his weakness, I'll have a hundred ways to destroy him."  Ella refuses to be Dante's fatal flaw. To make matters worse, her late father's arranged marriage contract sends another man to her doorstep.  Her childhood friend, Sebastian Vitali. He takes her hand and whispers, "I'm getting you out of here." But can she really trust him?  And when every piece of evidence points to Dante—the man she loves more than anything—as the one who murdered her father… will she be the one to pull the trigger?

Title: A Contract With The Disabled Billionaire
Synopsis: To save her dying mother, a desperate young woman is forced to marry a cold billionaire in place of her stepsister, beginning a turbulent contract marriage filled with secrets, betrayal, and unexpected passion.

Title: A contract with the italian
Synopsis: Ellie, a broke aspiring fashion designer who flees her toxic family in London to start over in Italy, agrees to a one-year fake marriage with wealthy real estate tycoon Vincenzo to help him secure his mother’s inheritance—only to find herself falling into a passionate, complicated romance while hiding her true identity and healing from her painful past.

Title: A Dorm With My Alpha Mate
Synopsis: To escape a forced marriage to a cruel alpha, Aria disguises herself as a boy named Arden and hides at an all-male wolf academy, where she forms a dangerous bond with the ruthless alpha heir Kai—who uncovers her secret, swears to protect her, and helps her fight for freedom against her vengeful father and the monsters hunting her.

Title: A Dragon Against the Whole World
Synopsis: The dragon's name is Galos. perhaps due to his hybrid red Iron blood and his human soul— a wondrous, unknown reaction occurred, granting him an innate talent greater than other dragons. — Adaptive Evolution. Whatsoever does not kill him shall only make him stronger. Before him, those who kneel shall live; those who remain standing shall die.   “Garos is my name. The world reveres and fears me, and honors me as the Eternal Immortal Dragon!”

Title: A love affair with Mafia Danger
Synopsis: Ivy, a former accountant pregnant after a one-night stand, is forced into a fake engagement with ruthless billionaire Luther — known as Don Danger — to protect his mafia family’s heir, while facing deadly threats, jealous rivals, and unexpected love.

Title: A Mother's Redo—Taming Chaos
Synopsis: After her murder, Ashley wakes up 13 years later, haunted by visions of her family's tragic future. Her movie-star husband is surrounded by copycats, her son becomes a felon, and her daughter is duped. Written off as a lost cause, Ashley is now their only hope to rewrite their destinies.

Title: A Night Of Pleasure A Deal Of Revenge
Synopsis: After being betrayed by her ex-boyfriend and best friend, a heartbroken woman enters a contract marriage with a powerful billionaire CEO, only to find unexpected love and partnership.

Title: Abandoned Luna: Mated to the Alpha Twins
Synopsis: Once cherished by two Alphas, Celeste is betrayed on her 18th birthday by the very men she loved—her childhood friends and fated mates. Swayed by a manipulative Omega, the two Alpha brothers humiliate and abuse the partner destined for them. Broken and scarred, she is rescued and fiercely protected by two even more powerful Alphas, rising from the ashes, reborn. After losing her, the two traitors fall to their knees, begging for forgiveness—but they will have to pay for what they’ve done.

Title: Accidentally yours
Synopsis: Five years later, the child was abruptly taken away. Then, a distinguished man forcefully entered her world. What? That man was the father of her child?

Title: After Ascension
Synopsis: A sword god ascends expecting paradise, only to find a realm where humans are prey. In a prison of despair, he unites blade, sword, and demon arts to break free. He builds the Sword Domain, a sanctuary where the defiant can stand and fight for their kind.

Title: After Divorce, I Became Rich And Owner A Company
Synopsis: Nadia, a housewife who for five years lived in the shadow of her husband, Adrian—a handsome but arrogant young entrepreneur—finally decided to divorce after being betrayed and belittled.

Title: After My Ex Cheated, I Became His Stepmother
Synopsis: After a car crash, heiress Nora fakes amnesia just to mess with her boyfriend, Davis. Instead, he uses it as his chance to cheat—and dumps her on his powerful father, Claude. Nora turns the tables by dating Claude, only to discover that he saw through her act from the very beginning... and has wanted her all along.

Title: After My Sister Was Murdered, I Became a Crimson Wraith
Synopsis: After his sister is brutally murdered, Gu Xi transforms into a Red-clad Wraith in a place of extreme yin energy and swears vengeance on the Wu Family, a clan of Ghost Tamers. He devours Grudge and slaughters every enemy in his path, only to discover that his sister’s soul has fallen into the Ghost Realm. To uncover the truth, he must enter Fengdu, guarded by seven Evil Fiends. This is a descent into the abyss—and a quest for redemption sworn in blood.

Title: After She Vanished, The Alpha King Regrets
Tags: Werewolf; Revenge; All-Too-Late; Weak to Strong
Synopsis: After enduring endless betrayal and cruelty from her Alpha King Eric, Katerina the Luna uses moon‑goddess magic to fake her death and vanishes without a trace. Convinced she is dead, Eric spirals into crippling regret as his empire crumbles around him. But Katerina is alive. Reborn with her true fated mate, she returns with divine power — and will never give him a second chance.

Title: Allure Of The Night
Tags: Vampire; Werewolf; First Love; Royalty; Forbidden Love
Synopsis: Eve, a fugitive mermaid princess disguised as a servant, infiltrates the Moriarty vampire clan to uncover the truth behind her mother’s disappearance. But at a shadowy underground auction, she inadvertently catches the eye of Vincent, the ruthless vampire heir. Enraged by jealousy, the aristocrat Marcelline stops at nothing to force Eve to reveal her tail. Eve outsmarts every deadly trap—yet she cannot mask the lethal scent of her blood. To vampires, mermaid blood is an irresistible poison. As Vincent wages war between sanity and his savage bloodlust, he helplessly falls for the girl who should be his prey, even as Eve realizes her mother’s dark fate lies buried at the very heart of the Moriarty clan.  As desire blooms amidst the shadows, can Vincent resist his primal hunger?  And can Eve unearth the truth without losing her heart—or her life?

Title: Alpha King's sex slave
Synopsis: A witch queen enslaved by a vengeful alpha king—passion, pain, and power collide.

Title: Alpha's Hated Mate
Synopsis: A powerful witch queen is captured and enslaved by a ruthless alpha king consumed by revenge, forcing her into a dark, forbidden bond of pleasure and pain.

Title: Alpha's Regret: The Seventh Time was Forever
Tags: Strong FL; Revenge; Second Chance; One Night Stand; Face-slapping; Hidden Identity
Synopsis: She forgave him six times. The seventh time, she signed without a single tear.  For six years, Luna Seraphine begged, bent, and bled for a mate who never once chose her. When Alpha Ravyn brought her the divorce papers a seventh time, he gave her a choice: accept Daisy as co-Luna, or sign. Seraphine signed — on one condition: she got to keep her son. Then came the truth that shattered her: the son she'd raised for six years was Daisy's. Her real daughter had been murdered at birth, her ashes buried beneath the pack's own foundation. Seraphine stopped forgiving. She started planning. One by one, her hidden identities emerged: founder of tech empire Mind Nest, the elusive Doctor S, the legendary hacker Nova Ghost. But she wasn't the only one deceived. Voren — Ravyn's closest friend and North America's most powerful Alpha — grows drawn to his friend's ex-wife, as the truth buried seven years ago begins to surface.

Title: An Affair with the Billionaire
Synopsis: Emerald Greene, a teacher with a broken heart, is rescued from drowning by a mysterious man. They start a no-strings-attached fling, but Emerald's world turns upside down when she discovers he's the father of one of her students. Torn between being a mistress or letting him go, Emerald faces a choice that's even harder when she realizes she needs him for revenge against her ex. Will she stay for love or leverage?

Title: An Enigma in the Bridal Chamber
Synopsis: Frank, a literature Ph.D., transmigrates as the despised Reid bastard, forced to marry the Quinns' simple-minded daughter. Winning over his alluring mother-in-law and beautiful sister-in-law with poetry by day, he trains in martial arts with a mysterious woman by night. But who is the woman sharing his bed each night?

Title: Anaconda Island: A Nest of Lies
Tags: Strong FL; Beast; Revenge; Apocalypse; Doomsday
Synopsis: The night Karin finds her fiancé cheating, she's trapped on a volcanic island where ancient serpents are stirring from a thousand‑year sleep. With a biologist's help, she must trigger a gas explosion to escape—and watch the man who betrayed her walk straight into the jaws of sacrifice. But one egg has already left the island. And in a city lab, it's beginning to hatch.

Title: Apocalypse Ground Zero: Refusing To Leave Home
Tags: Strong FL; Beloved by All; Apocalypse; Reverse Harem; Rebirth; Weak to Strong; Revenge; Superpowers
Synopsis: In 2130, Raven Blackwood (Rae)—executed by betrayal in her past life—wakes two months before the zombie apocalypse with all memories intact. Using a mystical jade space, she hoards supplies and builds an impenetrable fortress guarded by mutant vines. She gathers four devoted men: Silas (metal), Phoenix (fire), Nathan (wind), and Marcus (strength). But her reincarnated rival Jacqueline, now a warlord, attacks with armies. After a brutal siege, Raven defeats Jacqueline, exposes her atrocities, and secures peace. She finally finds love, family, and a home—everything she never had. The story ends with new survivors knocking at her gate, seeking the legend within.

Title: Awakening After Eons: Reborn to Sweep Across the Heavens
Synopsis: Ten thousand years ago, Ren Xing, who had orchestrated events for ages in secret, was on the verge of destroying the Dark Upheaval — only to be betrayed by the Six Source Gods he had personally raised. His physical body destroyed, he was imprisoned in the Realm of Absolute Despair. Two thousand years later, eight Great Emperors sacrificed their very existence to forcibly rescue Ren Xing's remains, hiding them away for eighty thousand years. Now, eighty millennia later, Ren Xing awakens. Leveraging his eons of preparation, he makes his final move in this era, embarking on a path to sweep across all the heavens.

Title: Baby System: I'm the Beast World's Only Hope!
Tags: Reverse Harem; Beast; System; Strong FL; Transmigration
Synopsis: Escaping on the verge of death and forced to mate, she becomes both the "Dragon Queen" and the "Wolf Queen" by virtue of her modern knowledge and sharp-tongued charm.

Title: Back to the 90s: The Rise of a Tycoon
Synopsis: When business rivalry pushes him to the brink of death, protagonist Shen Chen unexpectedly transmigrates to the 1990s. His wife and child are miraculously alive, and fate grants him a do-over.

Title: Battle Lord
Synopsis: Wolf King, leader of Wolf Fang, retires to China after defeating his arch-enemy. He finds his foster father Arthur injured by developer Don, confronts him, but is arrested. His sister Sloane gets Don jailed, provoking the Wei father‑son (Roman and Vince). They send "Seven Kills" assassins and short Red Beauty Group, but Wolf King thwarts them. He protects his sister's classmate Isabella—heiress of Hong Men. The Weis kidnap her; he rescues her. They frame him for robbery and put him in death row, but flight attendant Ava (daughter of the Jiangnan Governor) helps him escape. Wolf Fang assembles for a final reckoning with the Weis.

Title: Be a God for My Blind Follower
Synopsis: After transmigrating, I became the true god worshipped by a mountain village.  But I couldn’t feel happy about it at all.  For more than ten years, I hadn’t received even the slightest bit of incense offerings. Because of that, a crack had appeared on my true form, the divine statue.  Worse still, this village was crawling with demons, monsters, and evil spirits.  And my only believer was an old woman, Granny Liu.  Just as I was sinking into despair, footsteps suddenly came from outside.  Someone was here.  I turned to look and saw a young couple supporting an elderly woman as they slowly stepped over the temple threshold.  It was Liu Quan and his wife, together with my one and only believer, Granny Liu.  Could they be here to offer incense?  I hurried back into the statue and waited.

Title: Beastblood Unleashed
Synopsis: Liu Zhenhan, the King of Soldiers of the Southern Frontier, is transported to another world—and thrown straight into a living hell. After awakening War Songs sung in Chinese, he tames divine beasts and battles the Sea Clan. His sworn enemy is a prince, while the rich and powerful stand against him at every turn. Starting with absolutely nothing, Liu Zhenhan rises to dominate the realm. Armed with roguish swagger and unmatched strength, he turns the worst possible hand into an unbeatable one, forcing everyone who once looked down on him to bow at his feet. This unconventional rogue hero will restore the glory of Behemoth—and become the greatest wildcard in the entire world.

Title: Become A Football Legend
Synopsis: Lucas Brandt is a 36-year-old failure who survives by running up unpaid tabs at bars in Darmstadt, Germany. One night, while walking home, he saves a child who runs into the road but is struck and killed by a Ford F-150. When he opens his eyes again, he has returned to the age of fifteen—the exact moment when he was about to be expelled from his youth football academy. Fortunately, the Time Training System appears. Inside the system, one hour of training is equal to only one second in the real world. Lucas begins a brutal training regimen, rapidly improving his physical abilities and football skills. With the system’s support and the experience of his 36-year-old mind, Lucas completes the T-test agility drill in just 9.9 seconds at the SV98 training ground, breaking the academy record and stunning everyone present. His journey to becoming the God of Football begins.

Title: Becoming the Heirless Dragon King's Fated Mate
Tags: Dragon King; First Love; Royalty; R18
Synopsis: Laura, sold to a violent old man, escapes into a cave and bonds with silver dragon duke Kyle—becoming pregnant with his heir. They marry for the child, then fall in love. Despite rival schemes and assassination attempts, Laura discovers runemaster talent, gives birth to twins, founds an academy, and stands equal beside Kyle.

Title: Betrayed by the Champ, Loved by the Billionaire
Synopsis: Serena gave boxing champion Chris three years and ninety-nine chances — one pearl for every heartbreak he caused. When he crowns his championship win by choosing his ex over her, pearl ninety-nine falls. Done forgiving, Serena signs the divorce papers and walks away. But as she rebuilds her life, William York — the billionaire who's quietly loved her for years — steps out of the shadows. And this time, someone finally knows exactly what he's got.

Title: Between Lies and Love
Tags: Baby; Hidden Identity; Family; Face-slapping; Revenge
Synopsis: A stolen identity, a six-year lie, and a hidden secret daughter.  The fake sister steals everything, while the real mother returns for justice.  Fate reunites the long-lost lovers.  Truth revealed, lies shattered, and a destined family reunites at last.

Title: Billionaire Unintended Vow
Synopsis: Alana Reid had thought she was finally leaving the past behind her. Pregnant and heartbroken five years ago, she'd walked away from a cold, loveless marriage determined to rebuild her life away from Ethan Lancaster, a ruthless billionaire with a black-and-white outlook on everything including his women, Now she had all she'd ever wanted: her independence, her art, and her son, the only piece of that painful past she truly cherished.

Title: Bind to the Apocalypse System in the Modern Era
Synopsis: Chen Lie, once a prodigy of the Chen family, had his S-rank divine artifact "Thunder God Hammer" stolen, depleting his vitality and reducing him to a waste. Persecuted by his brother Chen Qingxu and the family elders, he was pushed to the brink of death — until he bound to the "Doomsday System." The problem? It mistook the high martial world for an apocalypse: killing mosquitoes counted as "slaying zombies," renting a shack as "building a shelter," and slapping villains boosted vitality. Exploiting these bugs, Chen Lie rose from a waste — crushing bullies, exploring forbidden zones, and dominating the martial exam with warrior-level power. Hounded by the Chen family, burdened by bizarre system missions, and caught in the collision of two mismatched worlds, he wielded the Cloud-Cleaving Palm and Chen Family Mad Blade to cut through enemies, unraveling the secrets of both the high martial realm and his doomsday system — forging a path of revenge and ascension.

Title: Blind Bride: Fate Turning
Synopsis: The blind girl Zoila Lance and the secret big shot Caleb Lawson got married while their families pressured them. That night, Zoila was almost killed but survived the disaster. With Caleb’s help, she took back her inheritance from her stepbrother when a car accident happened to the couple.

Title: Blood and Betrayal
Tags: Strong FL; Hidden Identity; Face-slapping; Revenge; Abusive Love
Synopsis: A wealthy heiress hides her identity for love, only to be betrayed and destroyed by her husband and a vicious mistress. Cruel abuse, painful miscarriage, and endless humiliation push her to the edge. When her powerful family arrives, the scumbags kneel in regret. She divorces, takes back her throne, crushes her enemies, and becomes the ultimate female ruler.

Title: Blood Doesn’t Make the Heir
Synopsis: Genius Cassie Pearce from another world takes over the body of a wealthy illegitimate daughter. In the face of relentless mockery, Cassie just smiles. With the worst hand dealt, she’ll flip the script—from fake heiress to tech CEO, from trash to genius, climbing to the top!

Title: Blood moon lover
Synopsis: Carl, a half-werewolf, takes his human wife Eve to an ancient castle for their honeymoon and reunites with his elder brother Miles, a vampire. The two accidentally swap souls. Their mother Vivian schemes to sow discord, claiming Eve must conceive a child bearing the blood of all three to restore their souls. Once the secrets of their races are revealed, Vivian attempts to murder Eve. The group fights desperately to shield Eve until she becomes pregnant, yet their souls remain displaced. An unforgiving condition is then presented to the three of them…

Title: Bloodsucking Evolution
Synopsis: Waking up as a mosquito, I thought I was doomed—until I unlocked the Bloodsucking Evolution System. My first bite? A reborn empress. Now she's devastated: her ultimate spirit beast contract was stolen... by a mosquito. But maybe this tiny pest will make her unstoppable.

Title: Born Backwards：The Cursed King
Synopsis: "Arthur was abandoned by his birth father, a Grand Duke, over seized family assets. Ella, a maid, rescued him and raised him through the years. Their peaceful life is shattered by the Grand Duke’s men, costing Arthur the person he loves dearly. Upon learning the truth of his origins, he lets go of the gentle memories of his past and heads into town. Blessed with extraordinary combat skills, he makes his way in underground fighting arenas, biding his time in silence. He is determined to reclaim his place in the family, seek justice, and uphold the gratitude and righteousness deep within his heart."

Title: Bound by Love: His Lordship Wants Only Me
Synopsis: Raised as the Li Family's child bride, Yin Mili is left widowed and survives by selling vegetables with her mother-in-law. After an unexpected night with Prince Xiao Shiyan, she gives birth to a son. To protect the child from a local tyrant, she secretly sends him back to the manor where they first met. Searching for work and her missing son, Yin Mili enters the Prince's Manor as a wet nurse. She and Xiao Shiyan slowly fall in love, but a painful misunderstanding leaves her convinced he is only toying with her. After enduring one trial after another, Yin Mili finally realizes his feelings are sincere, while Xiao Shiyan discovers that she is the mother of his own son. With every secret revealed, the two finally find their way back to each other.

Title: Bound to my Enemy
Tags: Power Couple; Strong FL; Contract Marriage; Enemies to Lovers
Synopsis: Elaine knows she’s running out of time.  So when her family decides to marry her cousin Ivy off to the man everyone fears, the ruthless and dangerous billionaire Zane Whitmore, Elaine willingly takes her place.  Their marriage begins as a deal and quickly turns into a war. She refuses to submit to his control, while he keeps pushing her boundaries. Yet somewhere between the fights, the provocations, and the danger, hatred turns into an attraction neither of them can resist.  Elaine thinks her biggest mistake was taking Ivy’s place and marrying Zane. But when the man she wants nothing more than to escape begins dreaming of a lifetime with her, she realizes that fate has played its cruelest trick by giving a woman with no future a man who wants nothing more than to spend his future with her.

Title: Bound To Ruthless Alpha Mafia
Synopsis: Alphaluciano of the Necromancer Wolf Clan, seeking vengeance for his murdered parents, intercepted the wedding carriage of the heir of the Froststone Wolf Clan, Arabella. Yet, he unexpectedly discovered that she was his destined mate. Capturing Arabella, Luciano sought to humiliate and control her as a means to avenge his kind against the Froststone Wolf Clan. He first imprisoned her in a dungeon, forced her to serve as his consort, and then publicly humiliated Arabella in front of all the wolf alphas, utterly destroying her dignity—just as he had done to her father, Vitalio.Arabella, deeply ensnared by her destined bond, was consumed by despair and agony, with no way to retreat.Luciano insisted on pursuing his own revenge plan, yet his icy exterior gradually crumbled amid his emotional entanglement with Arabella.

Title: Brand New Life Online: Rise Of The Goddess Of Harvest
Synopsis: Elaine, a young mother, is suddenly thrown into a virtual reality game because she wanted to reconnect with her daughter, but she’ll quickly find herself delving into endless conflicts, fights, action, and a world filled with history and mysteries…     Will our protagonist be able to progress through these challenges all while taking care of her farm, protecting the forest, and also seeking her daughter?     Who knows? Maybe she’ll even end up defeating a World Boss!

Title: Breath of love
Synopsis: Heaven, a hardworking and elegant wedding planner uninterested in wealth, travels to New York for work and unexpectedly falls for Alexandre, the hotel tycoon who is trapped in a forced family engagement.

Title: Broken Vow, Rising Wolf
Tags: Werewolf; All-Too-Late; Second Chance; Hidden Identity
Synopsis: Lyra Vane was the last Alpha of Mooncrest Pack.After burying her parents, she buried her power with them, hiding herself away as a wolfless Omega.Then her mate, Damien, betrayed her.He brought home Beta Morrigan and let them grind Lyra’s pride and honor into the dirt.But the moment Lyra picks up her blade again and swears revenge, her true mate arrives—Lucian, Alpha of Icefang Pack.

Title: Build an Empire, Rule the Wasteland
Synopsis: Locke, a former Federal elite, was trapped and exiled by his colleague Lucian in the red area of doomsday, awakening the double powers of Huangsha and thunder. He saved Lena, the orphan girl, and built a shelter in new Babylon with exiles. On the one hand, he led the people to live in the wilderness, and on the other hand, he collected evidence of Lucian's illegal human experiments and collusion with high-level officials. Finally, Locke led the Ministry to defeat the federal transformation army, smash the plot of ten people to survive, end class oppression, and let the people in the red and green areas usher in a new life of equality and stability.

Title: Cashback Made Me Rich
Synopsis: Lin Bei, a broke office worker, unlocks Spend Away, a tycoon system that rewards spending with insane cashback, luxury assets, and instant power. But just as his new life takes off, his wealthy birth parents appear, claiming he's their long-lost heir.

Title: Caught the Ice Queen
Synopsis: Reborn into his school days, a young man catches the untouchable, aloof school beauty stealing from his family's supermarket! Seeing the school's flawless goddess trapped against the wall, he makes a bold vow: he absolutely won't let her go today!

Title: CEO's Contract Lover
Synopsis: Highborn CEO Marcy Ballard, evading familial matchmaking pressures, encounters Monroe Crosby at a bar. Despite their age gap, Monroe keeps a cautious distance, but their subsequent experiences lead them into the depths of love, a turbulent yet captivating tale of mutual torment and affection.

Title: CEO's Love Story After Marriage
Synopsis: To save her foster father, Lu Qingge found herself entangled in an absurd marriage. Her contractual husband is the Dream guy in Haicheng, Li Jingheng, whose heart had been captured by an Angelic b*tch for many years.

Title: Charismatic Dr. Carl
Synopsis: Carl Smith, the King of Deity Palace, descends from the mountain to fulfill an engagement, all the while secretly investigating his parents' death. He plays possum along the way, giving those who looked down on him a taste of their own medicine, and eventually winning over the beauty.

Title: Chasing his Betrayed Ex wife
Synopsis: Following her divorce from Dominic, Clarissa was involved in an accident that erased all her memories.

Title: Chasing Madam Buchanan
Synopsis: Jane, a ruthless and powerful crime boss betrayed and left broken by her ex-husband Arthur years ago, is forced to ally with him when a deadly family syndicate targets her—uncovering the lies about her parents’ death and her hidden legacy.

Title: Cheated, Betrayed, Crowned: A Love Rewritten
Synopsis: Stella Cox witnessed her fiancé's affair with her sister. Her family forced her to break off the engagement. In despair, she met Orion Ford, heir to Ford Group, and they fell in love, starting a new life together.

Title: Checkpoints to Freedom
Synopsis: After hitting rock bottom, Li Younan unlocks a check-in system that rewards him with new skills wherever he travels. With no urgent missions or pressure, he slows down, explores the world, experiences different ways of life, and gradually finds healing, freedom, and a new self.

Title: Chosen by fate
Synopsis: On our wedding day, his beloved ex is back, and I become a laughingstock.

Title: Christmas Awakening: I See Your Countdown
Synopsis: Landon, a hardworking hotel cleaner, is betrayed by his wife Lisa, who wastes their savings and cheats on him just as his mother desperately needs medical help. After Lisa and her lover Kyle humiliate him, Landon gets into a car accident—and wakes up able to see everyone’s lifespan countdown and the hidden value of objects. Using this new ability, he rises from nothing to wealth, saves his mother, and catches the attention of Quella, a rich heiress moved by his integrity.

Title: Claimed by My Mafia Alpha King
Tags: Werewolf; Baby; Second Chance; Love Triangle; Weak to Strong; Face-slapping; Mafia
Synopsis: Rejected by her fated mate and sold at an underground auction, omega Irina is claimed by the terrifying Alpha King. Fleeing his possessive cage, she awakens her hidden power as the legendary Healer Queen. When the ruthless King lies dying to save their secret son, Irina faces the ultimate choice: let the monster perish, or heal the mate who claimed her soul?

Title: Claimed by the CEO Daddy
Synopsis: After a fateful encounter, Elaine Todd secretly raises the son, Andy, she shares with billionaire Jason Lance. When Jason discovers the child's existence six years later, their lives intertwine at his corporate empire. As their connection deepens, a newfound family begins to form, leading to a life beyond her dreams.

Title: Cleaner Princess：The boss is backing me up
Synopsis: Seraphina, a wealthy heiress, is framed by her stepmother and stepsister. She goes into hiding under an assumed identity and works as a hotel cleaner to gather evidence in secret. Though she is repeatedly harassed and framed by her malicious relatives, she stays true to herself and handles every ordeal with poise. Samuel, the powerful head of a conglomerate, notices her extraordinary resilience and quietly stands guard over her. When vicious slander targets Seraphina, the two join forces to confront the crisis, uphold justice, and wait patiently for the truth to come to light.

Title: Clone Rebellion His Deadly Double
Synopsis: "Clone Eve jolts awake on an operating table in an underground Manhattan laboratory. Beside her lies the cold corpse of her original host. The engraving “A-01” on the nape of her neck marks her as nothing more than an organ farm.  While on the run, she discovers she possesses all of Elena’s memories. Hot on her trail is Elena’s fiancé Adrian, a ruthless man who sees her merely as a runaway organ supply. When Eve sneaks into the ICU to see the comatose Elena, the woman’s fingers suddenly twitch. It turns out Elena has faked her illness for years, seeking evidence of criminal activity within Adrian’s underworld family.

Title: Combative Police officer: I Can See Others' Crime Record
Synopsis: Four deadly choices in life: Being a cop in M City! Absolute justice here means getting shot, PewPew. Victor finds himself in the body of a jail guard and discovers that his eyes can see a person's Crime Value! Only by outgunning the criminals can he uphold justice!

Title: Contract Marriage
Synopsis: Yasmine Snyder asked him cautiously, "Why do you wanna marry me?"  "Yasmine, it's fate... You can only tie the knot with me in this lifetime."

Title: Contract Marriage: The Replacement Groom
Tags: Power Couple; Contract Marriage; Mafia; Suspense; Sweet Love; Baby
Synopsis: After five years together, Jeslyn discovers her fiancé is sleeping with her stepsister—and coming after her grandfather and family fortune.  To protect everything she loves, she enters a marriage of convenience with a stranger, only to discover her new husband, Maverick, is a feared Mafia boss.  With a little matchmaker pulling them closer and danger closing in, their fake marriage begins to feel dangerously real. The contract was never meant to last. Their love might.

Title: Corporate Girlfriend
Synopsis: "Immediately the words left my mouth, I knew at once that I had chosen my words badly. Damien made no overt move, but his eyes went hard and dark. He began to walk towards me and I retreated in alarm, my pulse accelerating. He continued to stalk to my side untill he successfully backed me into a wall. He stopped in front of me and placed his hands on either sides of my head, caging me in. His head came down untill he was staring into my eyes. “That's where you've got it all wrong, bunny,” he murmured, his voice a low, velvety timbre sending jolts of arousal to my loins. “You are mine, you always have been. Make no mistake about that.”

Title: Corpse Stitcher: Rewards from the Dead
Synopsis: After waking up, Lin Shou becomes a corpse stitcher tasked with restoring beheaded bodies. But every corpse he stitches grants him strange rewards—ancient texts, secret arts, and mystical relics—pulling him into a hidden world of spirits and dangerous power.

Title: Countdown Before My Eyes
Synopsis: After a car accident with the CEO, Wendy Shord, delivery rider Claus Sutton gains the power to see everyone's remaining lifespan. He uses this ability to avert disasters, face his rivals, and master treasure appraisal—quickly rising to wealth and romantic success.

Title: Crown of Redemption
Synopsis: Princess Garcia Hodge was once a tyrant who humiliated and abused the five consort candidates sent by different races. After a prophetic dream in which she saw humanity fall and herself executed, she awakens determined to change her fate. She inherits the “Purification and Pacification” power of the First Queen and sincerely repents to the five men — Elvin (elf prince), Kane (human prime minister’s son), Drake (dragon heir), Selene (merman prince), and Logan (orc chieftain’s son). As she struggles to learn statecraft and earn their trust, the ancient evil “Nether” awakens. The five former enemies gradually become her loyal allies. Why do the four Rogue Kings lose control of their wolf spirits at her touch?  Which one holds her true fated bond?

Synopsis: In his past life, Leo was imprisoned, tortured to death by Damian, a ruthless mafia kingpin. Synopsis: To keep her mother’s last wish, Ravena seals her wolf spirit and her powerful silver‑moon power to marry Alpha Lucien. But when Chu Tianchen awakens, he enters the Earthbound Immortal realm and begins hunting down everyone behind the massacre. With no system and no mercy, the last heir of the Chu Family will make even the Imperial Family answer for its crimes.

Synopsis: Framed by her ruthless father, scheming stepmother, and venomous stepsister, heiress Nina Sklenar spends three years locked away, presumed forgotten. The day she walks free, she crashes her stepsister’s society wedding and claims the groom—Howard heir Xavier—for herself. As Nina reclaims her fortune piece by piece, she uncovers the buried truth behind her mother’s death, and her revenge turns deadlier than anyone imagined.

Title: From Sacrifice to Sovereign
Synopsis: Branded a powerless half-breed because she cannot shift, Ella is betrayed by her werewolf clan and thrown into the Eternal Night Abyss as a sacrifice to the vampires. Instead of dying, she awakens a forbidden bloodline—part ancient Moon Wolf, part Firstborn Vampire—and forms a dangerous alliance with Karen, the cursed and ruthless Vampire King. As Ella masters her dark new powers, she uncovers the truth about her imprisoned mother and the prophecy that has haunted Leon, the tyrannical Alpha King, for centuries. What begins as a quest for revenge grows into a rebellion uniting vampires, outcast wolves, and oppressed clans. With war closing in and love challenging everything she believes, Ella must choose whether to become the monster her enemies fear—or the queen who can end a thousand years of hatred and build a world where blood no longer determines destiny.

Title: From the Ashes: A Cultivator's Reckoning

Drifting through hairpin turns and pulling off death-defying overtakes, the carefree tamer becomes a track goddess the moment her hands grip the wheel, stunning every spectator. When an untamed beast meets a professional tamer, this enemies-to-lovers marriage of convenience can only end one way: him surrendering willingly, tamed by her — and her alone.

Title: Frost & Fever: Bound to the Monster

Synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland buried under eternal ice, Elara hides a deadly secret: her blood burns like molten lava, making her the last living source of heat in a frozen world. Kyle, Frost City’s most feared assassin, is sent to eliminate her. But during their deadly confrontation, an accident binds them together—her burning blood enters his body, creating an irreversible curse. Now they cannot separate. If Kyle moves more than ten meters away from Elara, he will burn to ash from within. If Elara leaves him, she will freeze into ice. Forced to stay together to survive, the assassin must protect the very woman he was meant to kill as they cross the frozen wasteland in search of a cure.
