Title: Good bye, My Princess
Synopsis: Nanjiang was captured by Yun. The lord of Yun cannot bear to kill the princess of Nanjiang, Leng Yue, thus locking her in Blood Tower, where she became a killer later. Taking her foe as her beloved, Yue was doomed to get hurt. Finally, she moved on and avenged herself…

Title: Goodbye Husband, I'm No Longer Yours!
Synopsis: "Those words split my world in two. One paper said advanced lupus nephritis. The other said sixteen weeks pregnant with twins.  So this was my choice. My life… or my babies."

Title: Gosh! I've Mistaken Ghost King's Tomb as My Grandpa's!
Synopsis: Lin Yu was the Ghost King. All he wanted was to lie in his coffin for eternity. However, there was a silly girl who had mistaken him for her deceased grandfather——every festival, she would come to sweep his grave and place offerings right on top of his tomb. The girl, named Xu Lin, was a talented ghost tamer, yet she faced death as the ghost eye within her body awakened. Just when she was in despair, the “grandpa” she had knelt before for years kicked off his coffin lid and climbed out. With just one glance, he scared away a top-tier fierce ghost. Then, to save her life, he removed her ghost eye and became a part of the girl’s body. From then on, a dual-souled super ghost tamer appeared in the world. Her left eye looked innocent and naive, while in the right eye, there lurked a fierce ghost with terrifying power. The two became entangled in all sorts of bizarre incidents, unknowingly starting to influence the entire paranormal world!

Title: GUNVERSE: Rulebreak Protocol
Tags: Game; Dungeon; System; Adventure; Weak to Strong; Game Transmigration
Synopsis: Cade, a professional esports player, is pulled into a game world that has become terrifyingly real. With a mysterious lottery system, he quickly rises to the top and defeats the game’s strongest boss.  But victory reveals the truth—this is not a game, but the beginning of a multiversal collapse where countless worlds are starting to merge and fall apart.  Armed with his system, Cade travels across different game-inspired dimensions—fantasy realms, pixel worlds, eldritch horrors, and FPS battlefields—fighting for survival and collecting fragments of the Core Code, the key to restoring reality.  As the crisis deepens, Cade realizes he is no longer just a player, but the only one capable of stopping the destruction of all universes.

Title: Harem Apocalypse: My Seed is the Cure?!
Synopsis: When a deadly virus turns the world into a nightmare, high schooler Ryan gets bitten by an Infected—along with his crush. Facing certain doom, they decide to go out with a bang, losing their virginity in what they think are their final moments.  But surprise—they don’t turn. In fact, they’re cured.  Turns out, Ryan’s seed has a miraculous side effect: it heals infected women. And that’s not all—he soon discovers unique powers of his own. Now, in a world overrun by monsters, Ryan has a new mission: survive, thrive, and build a sanctuary of powerful (and stunning) women who owe their lives to his very special ability.

Title: Harem in Another World
Synopsis: Transmigrated to a martial world, Gong Yu is immediately dumped by his girlfriend. But his luck turns when he signs 2 SS-rank campus belles. Armed with Gene Potion and Martial Art, he kicks off a completely different, invincible new life!

Title: Harem Streamer System: Every Crime I Broadcast Wins Me a Superheroine
Tags: SuperHuman; Harem; Weak to Strong; Hidden Identity; Superpowers; Comedy
Synopsis: Scott, an ordinary young man, unexpectedly unlocks the Hero Harem Livestreaming System and transforms into the masked vigilante known as Nightwatcher. Through his livestreams, he upholds his own sense of justice, stopping crimes throughout the city and battling the Black Gear Gang, a criminal organization armed with alien technology.  His girlfriend, Maya, possesses superpowers of her own, but after signing with a talent agency, she becomes caught up in the publicity-driven world of celebrity superheroes. Meanwhile, the popular superheroine Mercury is drawn to Nightwatcher’s pure and unwavering sense of justice and falls for him.  Scott’s childhood friend, Magwen, awakens the ability to transform into mist and joins him in battle. The mysterious heroine, Elena, known as the Night Demoness, uncovers the Black Gear Gang’s hidden conspiracy. As superheroes, criminal organizations, and powerful entertainment agencies become increasingly entangled, Scott continues his mission as Nightwatcher.

Title: He Has My Other Baby
Synopsis: Five years ago, Lily Smith gave birth to twins but lost her eldest son. After years of searching, she discovers James Hall with their child. Through comical misunderstandings, they develope feelings for each other and eventually uncover the truth behind the pregnancy mystery together.

Title: He Stole Me From My Deadbeat Husband
Tags: One Night Stand; Weak to Strong; Office
Synopsis: Katherine Woods built her career at Emperor Publishing while supporting her deadbeat husband Matt and her leeching sister Erin—only to catch them cheating to her face. After Matt forces her into an "open marriage," a drunken one-night stand with a stranger reveals he is Henry Grant, heir to the Grant empire. Pregnant at last, Kate learns five years of "infertility" was Matt's lie. With Henry at her side, she sets a trap that turns the cheaters against each other—and reclaims the life they stole.

Title: Healing Touch
Synopsis: Dear sister, don’t blame me. Dear my former betrothed, don’t flatter yourself. She said to a shadow, “He wants to take your woman.”

Title: Heirless Wolf King: His Contracted Lover
Synopsis: Betrayed by her stepmother, Princess Elena falls into the forbidden land of werewolves and meets the cursed Wolf King Karen. Their fated bond breaks his century-old curse, and she carries the only heir of the wolf clan. When humans sentence her to death, the ruthless Wolf King arrives with his pack and declares: “Who dares hurt my woman?”

Title: Her Four Kings
Tags: R18; Reverse Harem; Book Transmigration; System
Synopsis: A game-planner-turned-author transmigrates into her own unfinished novel as the cannon-fodder second female lead. She rises from the ashes to slap the original heroine in the face — and wins the hearts of the three male leads who'd been scripted to die. When the system forces her to pick just one, she arrogantly claims them all, rewrites the ending, and ascends to become the pampered queen of the story. Even the side characters, through sheer effort, can take center stage in their own lives.

Title: Her Highness Exposed, the Obsessive Lord Begs for Her Hand
Tags: Book Transmigration; Hidden Identity; Royalty; Playing Dumb; Strong FL
Synopsis: Shen Ling transmigrates into a puppet emperor who rules disguised as a man and unexpectedly becomes bound to the Foolish Emperor System. To stay alive, she racks her brains to play an incompetent tyrant. Her outrageous antics throw the royal court into chaos—and stir the heart of Gu Yan, the all-powerful Lord of Nine Thousand Years. Shen Ling’s sudden moments of intimacy gradually wear down Gu Yan’s resistance, until familiarity turns into fierce possessiveness. But when both their hidden identities are exposed, Gu Yan believes everything was part of Shen Ling’s scheme. Enraged at having been manipulated, he returns to neighboring Wu State, reclaims his identity as a prince, seizes the throne, and marches against Huai State. As they spend more time together, their misunderstandings finally unravel. They unite the realm and become lifelong partners.

Title: Her Last Wait at City Hall
Synopsis: After Vincent Moretti stood me up at City Hall for the seventh time, I cut off all contact with him. Phone calls? Blocked. Social media? Deleted. Family gatherings he attended, I refused to go. My company decided to partner with his casino, I resigned on the spot. My strategy was simple: a clean break. For thirty years, I gave him everything. I refused to live like that anymore. Better to be alone for the rest of my life than to wait one more night in an empty house that never felt like home.

Title: Her Majesty’s Revenge
Synopsis: Elizabeth watches her own sister-in-law poison her brother to death—and before she can even process the horror, her first love Charles reveals himself as a hidden prince and coldly casts her aside. Her world doesn't just crack. It burns to the ground. So she turns that fire into a weapon. Armed with her medical mastery, Elizabeth charms her way into King Philip's bed, claims the throne, and becomes her former lover's worst nightmare: his brand-new stepmother. She wants the woman who murdered her brother to burn for it. She wants Prince Charles to fall from grace and rot in hell for what he did to her. But a crown isn't enough to settle a blood debt. And as the final, bloody reckoning closes in, Elizabeth is forced to face the most dangerous truth of all—destroying the man who wronged her might mean destroying the love she never stopped feeling. Revenge or love. Betrayal or redemption. In a royal chess game played in blood, who will make the last move?

Title: Her Stepfather's Crush
Synopsis: "She thought it was harmless, just a silly crush on the man who suddenly became part of her family. But her glances lasted too long, her touches lingered too much, and her heart raced every time he walked into the room."

Title: Hibiscus Found
Synopsis: Within the power whirl of alchemical empire Blackwood, heir Sebastian’s love for underground alchemist Elara is broken up by his family. Elara carves the vault key as a blood totem into their twin kids Ivy and Rowan before her death. Rowan is kidnapped and loses his memory, while Elara leaves the Memory Vessel to Ivy. Eighteen years later, Ivy sneaks into Blackwood and reunites with amnesiac Rowan, whose blood totem proves their bond. Step-mother Victoria’s plots get exposed. Sebastian recognizes his children but slips into a deep coma after taking a bullet for Ivy. After three years of care, the twins wake him with supreme alchemical perfume and open their mother’s vault, which holds no riches but Elara’s love and light. Centered on "Follow your heart", this is an epic of blood, betrayal and redemption.

Title: Hidden Marriage with secret love
Synopsis: Everyone in Protpool knew that Mr. Fame had someone in his heart, but the very same person claimed to be single with a child, so he declared openly that whoever dared to marry his woman would face the consequences.

Title: His Beloved, Feisty Wife
Synopsis: Seven years ago, Jane Sullivan had a one-night affair with Sam Hunter and gave birth to twins. Her son was stolen from her, leaving only her daughter by her side. Now, Jane returns to the country with her daughter and crosses paths with Sam once again, but doesn’t recognize him.

Title: His Choice to Love, His Kin to Kill
Synopsis: My husband chooses to stay with his lover while his parents lie dying in a car wreck. I let him go. I handle the hospital crisis myself. In my past life, I forced him to abandon her and rescue his parents instead. His parents lived, but his mistress died in a car accident rushing to see him. My husband seemed fine with it at first. A year later, when I was heavily pregnant, he got his revenge. He poisoned my anniversary dinner and shoved me down the stairs.

Title: His Damaged Wolf, His Flawless Lie
Tags: Werewolf; Strong FL; All-Too-Late; Love Triangle; Abusive Love; Tragedy
Synopsis: My future mate Alpha Ethan was ambushed on our bonding eve while searching for my jewel. He survived, but his wolf was shattered and no longer knew me. The healer said my pureblood pup might awaken him.  I went to find Ethan, but overheard him lying to Beta Mason. He faked his wolf’s injury to delay the bond. He loved me but planned ten more she-wolves before returning.  Hurt and furious, I tore up the scroll and went to the forbidden grounds to get rid of the pup.

Title: His Frozen Luna
Synopsis: A week before our bonding ceremony, I overheard my mate talking to his friends. “You actually changed the location for Kira?” one of them teased. “Without telling your fiancée?” Then came his arrogant reply, laced with a smirk I could practically hear through the door. “It’s fine. She loves me so much she nearly died for me. She’ll do whatever I say.” He was so sure I’d follow him to that California beach. So on our bonding day, when his furious mind-link message finally came…

Title: His Scent Is A Moon Lit Lie
Synopsis: A teenage girl named Elara discovers an inexplicable connection with her mysterious new neighbor Jordan, who hides a supernatural secret and a dangerous pack conflict.

Title: His Silent Possession
Tags: Power Couple; Strong FL; Enemies to Lovers; Forbidden Love; Mafia
Synopsis: After her once-prominent family falls into ruin, Seraphina is forced to sign a humiliating contract to repay a crushing debt. To her shock, she discovers that the ruthless godfather of an underground lending empire is none other than Elias Thorne—her refined, reserved university literature professor.  By day, he is an elegant scholar admired by all. By night, he becomes the cold and calculating man who holds her fate in his hands.  As the two engage in a dangerous and intoxicating game of debt, power, and temptation, the boundaries between captor and captive begin to blur. But when a long-buried family vendetta resurfaces, their fragile balance is shattered. In a world where revenge and desire collide, the rules of the game are rewritten—and neither of them can tell where manipulation ends and genuine feelings begin.

Title: Hongtian Divine Sovereign
Synopsis: Qin Nian, the illegitimate son, was tricked by his half-brother Qin Hen into practicing the family's cultivation technique. His father, Qin Yuanshan, then crippled him — destroying his dantian and breaking all four of his limbs — under the pretext of "defying clan rules." His mother, Lady Xu, was killed while trying to protect him. Abandoned in the wilderness, Qin Nian's burning hatred awakened the Nine Dragons Supreme Divine Body (the strongest divine-level bloodline). He was rescued and underwent dual cultivation with the mysterious expert Bai Tianhan, after which he changed his name to Xu Nian and fully restored his cultivation base.

Title: Horror Game Developer: My games aren't that scary!
Synopsis: He built the nightmares. Now they're hunting him back.  Ethan was just another horror game developer — until a portal dragged him into a world of living dungeons, where every fear he ever coded becomes flesh and blood. Here, he crafts real horror games, and every scream he earns converts into points for game-changing items.  Sounds like a dream job... right?  Wrong. One by one, the monsters he abandoned are waking up — scrapped designs, cut characters, nightmares he once swore weren't good enough to ship. Each one remembers him. Each one is coming for him.  But are they really here for revenge... or something else?

Title: How to Tame Your Dragon King
Synopsis: After being forced to marry the Wolf King and killed by her jealous sister Isla, Amelia is reborn. Isla, using prophetic dreams, steals the Wolf Clan marriage contract, hoping to birth half-bloods and rule - unaware it will kill her. Amelia instead marries into the Dragon Clan, where the "degenerated" King Harvey has secretly awakened his true power. While Isla suffers as a breeding tool, Amelia gains wealth, power, and freedom, escaping her tragic past without regrets.

Title: Human Supernatural Suppressor
Synopsis: Cao Yi transmigrated into a world where the supernatural was reviving. By using his system to extract supernatural abilities, he rose from the most unfortunate transmigrator to an SSS-rank talent, making a name for himself in the Four-City Ranking Battle.

Title: HuntedLuna，HiddenPrincess
Synopsis: Separated Silver Moon princess Celine marries Blood Moon leader Ronan, suffering three years of cruel blood pool torture. She overhears Ronan, his mother and her best friend plotting to snatch her cub’s pure wolf soul to save their illegitimate son. Pregnant Celine flees desperately. Her father, the Silver Moon Wolf King, recognizes her via a wolf-tooth token and rescues her with her brothers. They expose the soul-sacrifice conspiracy and punish all villains. Finally, Celine ascends the throne as Silver Queen and guards peace across all northern wolf clans.

Title: Husband you’ve abandoned me. Fine, I’ll focus on raising my son
Tags: Power Couple; Back in Time; Revenge
Synopsis: Jasmine Towers married billionaire Keith Acland in an arranged marriage meant to benefit two powerful families. There was no love, no romance—and Jasmine accepted it. As the CEO’s wife, she devoted herself to maintaining the perfect image and raising her son to become the rightful heir of the Acland family. Everything collapses when Keith’s former lover returns… with a child she claims is his. Overnight, Jasmine’s position is questioned. Her son’s inheritance is threatened. And the woman who once stood quietly beside her husband is pushed out of her own home. Betrayed by her husband and abandoned by high society, Jasmine is forced into a ruthless battle for survival—where losing means watching her son lose everything. Jasmine must fight to protect her child...and reclaim what was stolen from her.

Title: I Build a Shelter in the Eternal Night
Tags: Weak to Strong; Kingdom Building; System; Suspense
Synopsis: The Heaven-Devouring Crocodile unearths a vast trove of earth-gold, yet the Mortal Realm lacks artifact refiners. Qi Yue arrives to pass on her martial knowledge, hoping to entrust everything she has learned to the Gongyang clan. Seizing the opportunity, Chen Fan opens the Mortal City marketplace, sweeping across the major factions with ultra-low-priced Ghostfire and Skeleton Horses. He then launches a credit-based trust system, igniting a massive north-south trade boom overnight.  By chance, he also obtains an Architect’s Token, officially expanding the Mortal Realm’s commercial territory. The rise of Mortal City is now unstoppable.

Title: I Found An Evil Soulmate From The Hell
Tags: Hidden Feelings; Contract Marriage; First Love; Sweet Love
Synopsis: After losing her job, her boyfriend, and all hope in a single day, Lisa accidentally awakens Lucifer, the King of Hell. Unbeknownst to her, she carries the missing fragment of his soul—the only thing that can restore his power. Desperate to reclaim what is his, Lucifer forces his way into her life, only to discover their souls have become mysteriously bound together. As desire, danger, and destiny intertwine, an unlikely romance begins to bloom, forcing them to choose between power, love, and the fate of both Heaven and Hell.

Title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King
Tags: Strong FL; Baby; Revenge; One Night Stand; Rebirth; Face-slapping
Synopsis: Falsely condemned to bear only lowly mongrels, Moonwolf she‑wolf Aurora is viciously harmed by her husband and clan leader Tristan. Reborn on the day of the political marriage, she hears the hateful prophecy again and watches Tristan wed her sister to produce a noble Silverwolf.  On a full‑moon night, Aurora slips into Moonillusion Bar and surrenders herself to the trapped, heat‑stricken ancient wolf god Fenrir for a child. Their fiery night frees Fenrir from his thousand‑year bonds. He shocks everyone by claiming the pregnant Aurora as his bride.  She delivers a supreme wolf king. Her powerful bloodline erases every disgrace. The traitor and her scheming sister kneel in defeat. Aurora changes her fate and gains unmatched glory.

Title: I Have 10,000 SSS Rank Villains In My System Space
Synopsis: This is the story of a man who had no choice but to become a villain.  But not just any villain because even villains have standards.  This is the journey of a man learning how to become one. And to help him, the MC has access to an unlimited number of villains in his System Space, pulled from across all realities from every known dimension: Murim, Cultivation, Supernatural, Urban, Martial Arts, Mecha, and beyond.  So what is it that Razeal can learn? What can he teach? And why?  Come watch this

Title: I Only Summon Villainesses
Tags: Harem; Adventure; Weak to Strong; Transmigration; Academy; System; Comedy
Synopsis: My name is Cade Marlowe, and I don't summon heroes. In a world where Spirit Summoners bond with legendary heroes to save civilization, I awakened as F-Rank—the absolute weakest. While my classmates summoned knights, saints, and mythic champions, my summoning glitched. The circle turned red, and when the smoke cleared, I was staring at the Tyrant Empress—a Calamity-tier villainess who nearly destroyed the world 8,000 years ago. Everyone calls me cursed. Dangerous. A threat that should be eliminated. They're right to be afraid. Because the Tyrant Empress wasn't the only one who answered my call. And unlike the others, my strength is forged in pleasure. Through forbidden dual cultivation with my villainesses, I grow without end.

Title: I See the Aura of the Great Emperor in All My Disciples
Synopsis: Have been slacking off for 20 years, the carefree Changsheng Lu was forced to accept nine world-defying disciples. They sliced galaxies, foresaw destiny itself, or commanded demonic cultivators to call Lu Grandmaster, all imposing punishments on him. He needed just one last win before he could finally retire.

Title: I Traded My Life for His Glory
Tags: Abusive Love; Baby; Love Triangle; Strong FL
Synopsis: Ella, a poor girl, loves nobleman Kael with all her heart. To help him reclaim his family’s lost territory, she makes a deadly deal with a demon and summons an undead army. But afterward, she deliberately pretends to be greedy and heartless, leaving Kael behind so he will hate her and move on. Six years later, Ella lives under a false identity, raising their son alone while suffering from a deadly abyssal curse. Meanwhile, Kael has been deceived by Isabelle into believing Ella betrayed him. He repeatedly humiliates Ella, unaware of the sacrifice she made for him. Kael’s friend Roderick secretly investigates the truth. At the wedding, a memory stone finally exposes Isabelle’s lies—she stole Ella’s credit and orchestrated the downfall of the Aleramici family six years ago. But by the time Kael learns the truth, it is too late. Ella exhausts her soul and disappears, leaving Kael with nothing but endless regret and their young son.

Title: I want an ugly secretary
Synopsis: Denis, a beautiful young woman deeply in love with the womanizing CEO Leonardo, disguises herself as an ugly, old-fashioned secretary to win his heart, only to spark his unexpected obsession as he slowly uncovers her secret.

Title: I Woke Up Six Years Later as My Archrival’s Long-Lost Love
Synopsis: Sylvia Vance rescues the gravely injured Julian Garrett. Captivated by his good looks, she keeps him confined in her mansion, teasing him for her own amusement.  But in the blink of an eye, Sylvia suddenly wakes up six years in the future—with a little girl calling her “Mommy”!  Even more astonishingly, the girl has a “mouth of doom”: every ominous thing she says comes true.  After overcoming her disbelief and accepting this bewildering new reality, Sylvia sets out to uncover what happened during the six years missing from her life.

Title: I'm My Boss's Only Cure
Synopsis: "Dominic, a dashing suit-clad mafia boss and corporate CEO with a sculpted eight-pack, suffers from an extreme aversion to all women—yet he is utterly addicted to the natural scent of Olivia, a stunning rising star in the entertainment industry. Dominic moves aggressively to claim and confine her as his exclusive antidote. However, Olivia’s presence draws ferocious retaliation from his sworn rivals, the Falcon Family. At an underground auction, the enemies trap them with poison gas and bombs. To shield Olivia, Dominic sustains critical wounds and collapses in a pool of blood. The foes hold his life hostage, forcing Olivia to submit to humiliating degradation before their eyes. As the countdown to catastrophe ticks away, this wounded, dying tyrant on the brink of collapse is about to unleash unbridled rage."

Title: Immortal with Hex Augment
Synopsis: After transmigrating into a perilous cultivation world overrun by demons, Xiao Chen becomes a lowly servant disciple of the Flame Sect. With no talent or backing, his path to immortality seems doomed—until he awakens a mysterious system.

Title: Inescapable Love
Synopsis: Nora Levin, whose family was brutally ruined when she was young, married her enemy under the alias of Nichole Jett and returned home as the madam. As she got along with the seemingly united father and son, she discovered that the man who was called Ray Moore was not Jacob Moore’s son. Under the same roof, the fake stepmother and the fake son were at war while they were In love with each other.

Title: Insta Millionaire
Synopsis: Start life anew, achieve wealth and success by starting with collecting and selling scrap!

Title: Introvert Billionaire’s Sassy Love.
Synopsis: A carefree 18-year-old girl is forced into an arranged marriage with a cold, arrogant 24-year-old man; they clash constantly but slowly fall in love, only to be torn apart when she learns their marriage was a business deal.

Title: Invading The Billionaire's Heart
Synopsis: Pregnant and desperate for work, Jasmine accidentally crosses paths with the cold, wealthy CEO Jason; after her heartless boyfriend betrays her, she becomes entangled in Jason’s world as he is forced to marry to inherit his family’s company.

Title: Invincible Soldier King
Synopsis: As a sharpshooter and the captain of the Green Dragon Squad, Blade accidentally gained the ability to see through objects after his right eye was injured. He concealed his identity, lived in Seasy City, and was forced to marry a beautiful CEO.

Title: Invisible Security Guard
Synopsis: Yusuf Zuck got betrayed and ambushed by his best friend and fiancee. Having the unique ability of invisibility, he successfully avenged himself and scored the hotshot CEO...

Title: Isekai Streaming In Another World
Synopsis: Streamer Adam has been trying to keep his streaming career alive but it was hard to stay afloat.     Everything changed when he gets the ability to travel to another world and stream his experience there to his viewers——With this ability, he starts on the path to be the number one streamer of the world!    But the other world is not just sunshine and rainbows, can he actually survive in a world of magic and dragons as a streamer?

Title: It was him!
Synopsis: Irina, a wronged young woman betrayed by her stepmother and half-sister, inherits a hidden property after her father’s death, carries an unknown baby

Title: It's All About Making Things Up
Synopsis: Li Xuan transmigrated. He was a nobody, idling his life away. One day, Xu Yan came and begged Li to teach him martial arts techniques. Li wanted to turn Xu down, but Li couldn't give Xu's greeting gifts up. So now, Li is Xu's master, who keeps making techniques up.

Title: It's Love, After All
Synopsis: Nancy Seaton married Jeremy Fillion after she found out about her ex-fiancé's affair. Both of the couple actually fall for each other as time goes by. They stand side by side and crush the conspiracy to usurp the Fillion's properties together. Where is this going? To a happy ending!

Title: It's Too Late To Regret Divorce, Mr. CEO
Synopsis: "Jewelry Designer Emma White was saved by billionaire Will Jones, realizing she fell in love with him at the first sight, she agreed to marry Will after making a deal with Will's grandma.But after three years of marriage, Emma became a substitute for Will's deceased girlfriend Casey, constantly being Ignored and humiliated. When Emma was pregnant and kidnapped, Emma's plea for help was coldly rejected by Will, at that moment, she was completely heartbroken and decided to get a divorce. After her divorce, Emma returned to the workplace and rose to become a top designer. As Will got to know more about Emma,he realized he had been in love with her long time ago, Will started to regret divorcing Emma and decided to chase her back.But both they had secrets that that they wanted to hide from each other, behind Will's indifference, there seemed to be unspoken story.

Title: Jade Vision: Rise from the Rough
Tags: The Chosen One; Counterattack; Superpowers; Business
Synopsis: An act of courage that costs Leon Smith his job unlocks an unbelievable destiny: X-ray vision. His rescuee, CEO Anna Clark, makes him her assistant. At a jade bidding conference, his miraculous ability to see inside rough stones launches his stunning rise to fame.

Title: King's Awakening
Tags: War God; Family; Revenge; War; Superpowers
Synopsis: White Mitchell spent his life speaking in bullets and living on the edge. Ultimately, his family paid the blood price for his sins. Seething with vengeance, he gathered his White Army and trusted lieutenants in the city and ordered swift death to all who dare challenge the might of the White Army's General!

Title: Kiss, Cry, Conquer
Tags: Empress; Book Transmigration; Enemies to Lovers
Synopsis: Bored and mocking a romance novel's seven evil characters, Yvee Jasper gets blasted straight into the story itself and thrust into the body of the wicked princess of the Velaryn Empire in an interstellar beast world. Seven villainess rivals? She'll crush them all without breaking a sweat.

Title: Knot me on ice, Captain(BL) Season 1
Tags: Athlete; BL; Sports; Enemies to Lovers
Synopsis: From sworn enemies to lovers, the two get together after clearing up all misunderstandings and win the championship through tacit cooperation.

Title: Knot me on ice, Captain(BL) Season 2
Tags: Athlete; BL; Enemies to Lovers; Sports; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Moments after winning the Championship, the pinnacle of their pro athlete careers, Kayden and Rhys are plunged into the darkest hour of their lives. Kayden's secret is exposed—an Omega disguised as an Alpha. Threatened to leave the Avalanche, Rhys, the elite Alpha captain, walks away from a hundred-billion-dollar inheritance to support Kayden. But Rhys' pro-elite grandfather, Rami, refuses to relent. He buys the rival team—puts Kayden's arrogant, incompetent pure-blood Alpha brother, Raymond as captain, and recruits Rhys's ruthless Beta ex, Damian. With Kayden's chance to play on the ice being stripped, the two vow to start from the bottom, win the league championship and force the pro league to rewrite its rules!

Title: LEAGUE OF ALPHA'S : TRILOGY
Synopsis: Mia, a downtrodden omega werewolf who hates the ruthless twin alphas who killed her father, is horrified to discover they are her fated mates—and they have chosen her as their Luna to bear their pups, trapping her between revenge, fear, and an irresistible bond.

Title: Legend of Dragon
Tags: The Chosen One; Inhuman MC; War; Cultivation
Synopsis: The Sixth Prince Zhao Zhen got exiled to the border, and now he has become the invincible god of war Dongfang Loongfei. Despite his return in disguise, he faces betrothal cancellation by Zhu Qianluo over their status disparity. Amidst their uncertain love, a sinister plot from the Zhuangloong quietly unfolds...

Title: lmmortal Kiss
Synopsis: "During a routine eradication mission, vampire hunter Raven drives her blade through the heart of an unknown vampire, only to discover the ancient bite mark on his neck perfectly matches the scar above her collarbone. A mysterious man named Damon emerges from the shadows, claiming that six hundred years ago, he pulled her back from the brink of death with his own blood and granted her immortality. As his blood servant, her memories were erased by Victor, leader of the hunter order, who remade her into a weapon tasked with hunting her own kind.

Title: Longevity by Picking up Attributes in the Battlefield
Tags: War God; Weak to Strong; Transmigration; System
Synopsis: Zhao Feng, a modern teen, transmigrated to the late Warring States Period during the Qin-Han war. He awakened a Corpse-Looting System. By looting corpses on the battlefield, he gained stats, treasure chests and martial arts.   Starting out as a logistics soldier, he climbed to the top. He slew Han generals and rescued Wang Yan, and made sworn brothers like Wei Quan. He saved the Queen Mother of Qin, then defended Weicheng and routed the Wei army. He also defeated famed Zhao generals Lian Po and Pang Nuan one by one, helping Qin conquer Han and Zhao. He wielded overwhelming authority, reunited with his family, and swore to unify the whole realm.

Title: Lord Marce's Return
Synopsis: To make his wife the princess of Dasor, Edwin Hardy gave up his title as Lord Marce and his engagement with War-god Marcia. While he had been planing for the ceremony of the enthronement in secret for three years, his wife showed him a divorce agreement.

Title: Lord of Winter: Beginning with Daily Intelligence
Synopsis: Amid the howling winds of the frozen north, Louis Calvin stands alone atop an icy cliff, wrapped in a wolf-pelt cloak.  Cast into this eternal wasteland by his own family under the guise of "glory," he awakens a daily intelligence system just as death seems certain:  【Thirty-seven frost-wolves lurk in the southeast valley — they strike tonight.】 【A tide of dragons will sweep the continent; humanity will barely survive.】 ...  He begins gathering witches — women branded heretics and hunted for their powers — judging none by birth or "purity," only by talent and sincerity, building with them a land where anyone can belong.  While southern nobles scheme over thrones, Louis's cavalry has already crushed the barbarian tribes, and frost dragons roar above the Iron Wall.  Winter has come, and this storm will swallow the continent.

Title: Lost in sin
Synopsis: "It was the most forbidden love, between the daughter of a fallen family and the heir of the one who crushed them. Juliet tried to run, but Ryan refused to let her go. He didn’t care about the past, the rivalry, or the whispers that surrounded them. He only cared about her."

Title: Love Across 1,000 Years
Synopsis: Alex finds Chloe, a woman claiming to be from 1,000 years ago. As love blooms, her heart remains with family in the past. He lets her go, but fate gives her a second chance. Sent back to three days before they met, she now chooses to stay with him forever.

Title: Love Drowns In the Lake
Tags: All-Too-Late; Weak to Strong; Love Triangle; Mafia; Tragedy; Abusive Love
Synopsis: In six years of marriage, Dante Moretti betrayed me three times. First, at an underground casino, he slept with a girl and claimed he must take responsibility for her. Second, to please her, he locked me in a warehouse for three days when I was seven months pregnant. Our baby’s heartbeat stopped. Third, when the girl fell ill and needed my kidney, he strapped my ventilator-dependent mother into his sports car and raced along a cliff highway. I knelt and begged: “I’ll donate it. Let my mother go. I’ll do anything.” Dante smiled and pressed the remote. The car crashed through the guardrail. I watched my mother fall into the lake. “Remember this,” he said. “This is what happens if you make Isabella suffer.” “Obey me, and everything can go back to normal.” But I knew there was no going back. Dante, there would never be a future between us.

Title: Love in lockup
Synopsis: Hollywood starlet Amber is imprisoned for murdering her husband. She accidentally catches the abstinent warden Cross secretly watching her films. What begins as a transaction of desire gradually develops into true love. Amber suffers constant bullying in prison, and Cross saves her time and again. With his help, Amber finally finds out that the real killer is her own stepdaughter. Faced with Cross being suspended and herself trapped in despair, the two rise up, break free from their identity barriers, and gain freedom together.

Title: Love Is Gone, So Am I
Tags: Revenge; Weak to Strong; Second Chance; Love Triangle
Synopsis: June Miller believed her marriage to Martin Davis was unshakeable. He was a renowned lawyer, and she was the wife he vowed to protect—until a deadly fire took her stepfather's life, and Martin personally sent her to prison. Three years later, June walks free, only to find the locks changed and Martin's ex-girlfriend Bella living in her home. To clear her name and uncover the truth behind the fire, June must gather evidence from the shadows of her past. Along the way, she crosses paths with Ethan, a mysterious young lodger whose bright smile hides secrets of his own. As old betrayals surface and new alliances form, June discovers that freedom demands the courage to face the truth—and that love can be found in the most unexpected places.A story of betrayal and redemption, loss and rebirth. When love becomes a prison, the only way out is through.

Title: Love lsland The Fake Heiress
Synopsis: "Mia, heiress to a media conglomerate, disguises herself as an ordinary young woman to join *Heart Lock*, a romance reality show funded by her family. She hopes to find pure love and expose the malicious editing prevalent in the industry. Eager for views, the show’s director deliberately manipulates footage, dragging Mia into a storm of online harassment. Ethan, a once-celebrated actor whose fame has faded, is the only one who stands by her, and romance blossoms between them as they spend time together.  Meanwhile, a hacker keeps releasing clues that shift public opinion, while several contestants step forward to reveal the truth. On the night of the live finale, Mia unveils her true identity in front of the audience and presents full evidence to hold those who broke the rules accountable.

Title: Love Tangles with My Brother-in-law
Synopsis: Accidentally, Jason Hale offended Julian Hirst, her evil brother-in-law! When she would have hell, Julian exposed his soft side! He invited himself into Jason's bed naked! Jason was the fiancée of Ryan Hirst, Julian's older brother, yet their fate tangled! What might happen after that crazy night?!

Title: Loved by Day, Claimed by Night
Tags: Revenge; Love Triangle; Hidden Identity; Superpowers
Synopsis: Nadia, a lowborn thief, disguises herself as a man and climbs a thousand-meter-high Sky City with her bare hands to save her younger sister, who has been chosen for “Ascension.” But she soon uncovers the horrifying truth: Ascension is nothing more than a ritual sacrifice, while the city’s ruler is a living power source who has been nailed to the Gods’ Engine for three hundred years.  Caught between the austere Light Guardian Oriane and the obsessive Shadow Lord Lucien, Nadia turns herself into a pawn in a deadly game that manipulates the souls of gods and demons. In the end, she joins forces with oppressed mortals and rebel mages to destroy the cursed Gods’ Engine, overthrow the tyrannical Senate, and build a new City of Light where mortals and mages stand as equals.

Title: Lust For Me, Daddy's Good Girl
Synopsis: After her chooses another woman over her, a brokenhearted girl finds reckless passion and protection with a mysterious, dominant stranger who vows to ruin her completely.

Title: Married My Teen Crush
Synopsis: Reporter Jayleen Carrillo flash-married A-lister Landyn Stafford. After Landyn mentioned his marriage on air, the industry blew up. Jayleen's half sister Alyson Carrillo claimed to be Landyn's wife, mocked Jayleen for "marrying broke," and kept sabotaging her, while Jayleen handled Alyson's digs with sharp grace.

Title: Married The Mafioso I Saved
Tags: Revenge; Flash Marriage; Abusive Love; Mafia
Synopsis: Hannah gave up everything for her fiancé, only to be brutally betrayed and abandoned in the States. Desperate to stay, she flash-married Alex, the "street thug" she accidentally saved with a single kiss during his escape. Passion ignites as Alex shields her from her vengeful ex and every threat. As their new life unfolds, Hannah starts to realize Alex might be more than just a street stranger...

Title: Married to a Curt Professor
Synopsis: "Zein smirked and turned his gaze to Intan. ""Marriage isn't important to me. I accepted this arranged marriage only out of respect for my parents. If you can cancel it, go ahead! But sorry, I don't have time to discuss such trivial matters,"" Zein said. Then left Intan Zein's attitude made Intan hate him even more, especially when she was sent to the border for an internship. However, while interning at the border, Intan met Fabian, an army commander guarding the border.  The turmoil began when Fabian began to approach Intan, while Zein also began to develop feelings for her."

Title: Married to a Stranger’s Empire
Synopsis: Keira Olsen, an illegitimate daughter forced into marriage with a thug by her father to benefit her sister, accidentally discovers she’s actually married to Lewis Horton, head of the wealthiest Horton family. But he has no memory of their marriage and harbors deep misunderstandings about her.

Title: Married To My Ex's Father
Synopsis: "Does Glenda reunite with her lover, Brian? Or does she find comfort in the arms of her lover's father, Maurice?"

Title: Married To The Mad Vampire Lord
Tags: Vampire; Enemies to Lovers; Strong FL; Contract Marriage; Weak to Strong; R18; Royalty
Synopsis: Isabelle, a human maiden, is forced to take her sister’s place and wed Lord Rohan, the mad vampire lord, within the perilous Nightbrook Castle. Trapped in a dangerous den, she lives in constant fear while testing her mysterious husband. Gradually, she uncovers his dark secret: he lost his heart and suffers from a corrupting curse beyond his control. Letting go of her prejudice, Isabelle chooses to save him. Meanwhile, she exposes the cruel blood slave trade, Cordelia’s scheme to impersonate her, and the sinister threats lurking from the Realm of Death. Filled with tangled romance, faction conflicts and stories of redemption, the series brims with twists, paving the way for a brand-new dark chapter.

Title: Marry a Billionaire CEO
Synopsis: After discovering her partner's infidelity, Wendy Grace impulsively marries Gabriel Jackson. Embarking on a bittersweet yet tumultuous journey, the two navigate the complexities of love.

Title: Marrying My Secret Crush
Synopsis: James Miller met a stranger kid. But he doesn't know the kid is his own son with his secret crush from a one-night-stand.

Title: Martial Arts: A Year's Progress Every Day
Synopsis: Born into poverty, Huo Yuanhong dreams of living with dignity and forging a path for others like him. When the Martial God System awakens, every day of training grants him an entire year of progress. Defying overwhelming odds, he rises from a nameless underdog to Tianjin's greatest fighter—and ultimately the greatest martial artist in the world. As he carries traditional martial arts to new heights, Huo Yuanhong shows the world the true meaning of the martial spirit and becomes a beacon of hope for countless young men born into hardship.

Title: Master Fuller, Your Wife Has Secret Identities Worldwide
Tags: Strong FL; Hidden Identity; Face-slapping; Contract Marriage
Synopsis: Jade Jenkins rescues a wounded imperial tycoon, knocks him unconscious, strips him, and performs extensive surgery on him. When he wakes, he searches the world for the audacious woman, turning the entire Imperial Capital upside down—never imagining she is the country wife he has just married.  Unaware of the truth, Master Fuller looks down on her and orders, “Divorce me in 100 days.” But his wife is hiding one identity after another: she is a military expert, the Nine-Needle Miracle Healer, the master of the Embroidery Pavilion, and the secret owner of a century-old pharmacy.

Title: Mated to My Fiancé’s Alpha King Brother
Tags: Power Couple; Weak to Strong; Office; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Seraphina Knight has always been the pack’s lowest rank—an unwanted Omega, betrayed by her family and abandoned by the masked stranger who gave her a son. Five years later, desperate to build a life, she becomes the personal assistant to Damian Nightshade, the most powerful Alpha King in the territory.  But Damian is no stranger. He’s the one-night lover she never forgot—and the father of her child. Their reunion ignites a mate bond neither can deny. As rogue attacks escalate and a deadly conspiracy from the past resurfaces, Seraphina discovers a shocking truth: she was never an Omega.

Title: Mated to the Enemy Alpha
Tags: Werewolf; Enemies to Lovers; Abusive Love; Suspense; Step-Siblings
Synopsis: Jasmine was the bastard daughter of Alpha Bell, forced to serve her family and the entire pack. Her life takes a drastic turn when she is forced to switch places with her half-sister and marry the handsome, cold-hearted Alpha Xaden. He swore to make the daughter of his enemy suffer. But the Moon Goddess might have other plans for the two of them!

Title: Mecha Girls & The One Who Wakes Them
Tags: Harem; System; Beast-Taming; Weak to Strong; Revenge; Space War
Synopsis: In the era of Mecha Girls, D-rank driver Mu Chen awakens the Talent Infusion System. Betrayed by his girlfriend, he partners with his broken tank-girl teacher, forging her into an SSS-rank war goddess. Together, they crush Calamities, liberate enslaved Mechas, and usher in a new age of freedom.

Title: MMORPG : Rebirth Of The Strongest Guild Master
Synopsis: In 2100 at the turn of the century the first full dive VMMORPG game 'Omega' was released. With its breath-taking graphics and possible adventures many players flocked to the game, but it all changed when the fun game currency had equated a real life value ......starting the money rush! Elite players made guilds and continued to rise but those at the bottom could only suffer in silence. Rudra was such a bottom rung player, he had excellent reflex and was a great team leader , however his guild wronged him, his efforts only reaped rewards for his superiors.  Used as a slave by the guild as a expendable worker class he died one night when he's betrayed by a close ones. Luckily he had experienced rebirth, and was one step ahead of everyone else. Luckily, He had the chance to get back at everyone who wronged him and help everyone who stood by him.

Title: Mom's Ultimate Rescue Mission
Synopsis: After a fatal car crash, Sophie time-travels 20 years into the future. To her horror, her sons have become ruthless rivals, and her daughter is being manipulated. She must undo this tragic future and reunite her broken family, before it's too late.

Title: Moon Reverse
Synopsis: "A-list actress Evelyn suffers from imposter syndrome. To ease her persistent sense of unworthiness, she resorts to self-harm through breath restriction and pain stimulation. Her new assistant Claire stumbles upon her secret. Initially forced to comply with Evelyn’s self-destructive acts, Claire gradually gains the upper hand in their dynamic. Trapped in a tangled web of codependency, manipulation and emotional friction, the two uncover the childhood trauma haunting Evelyn. Claire evolves from a mere pawn into someone who holds profound sway over Evelyn’s heart. Their bond undergoes an irreversible shift after a dangerous incident where Evelyn is drugged and Claire risks everything to save her."

Title: Mr. Aaron's Contract Marriage
Synopsis: To pay off her father’s massive debt and save her sick mother, Bella enters a cold contract marriage with the ruthless CEO Aaron

Title: Mr. Lawyer, You Put the Judge behind Bars?
Synopsis: How can a bank prove that the money in its vault actually belongs to the bank?  I am a lawyer with an extraordinarily high win rate. On a normal day, I can put my opponent behind bars. On an exceptional day, I can even take down the judge. Even the top attorneys have to call me their mentor.  But after an accident, I unexpectedly transmigrated into another parallel world.

Title: Mrs. and Mr. Smith
Synopsis: Ethan Smith never expected that three years of marriage would end with betrayal. As an underdog, Ethan also never expected that a girl like her would give him her all. Emily, it's my turn to care for you.

Title: My Accidental Husband is a Billionaire!
Synopsis: Keira Olsen inadvertently married a tycoon, unaware of his true identity. While one struggled as an illegitimate child fighting for survival, the other lived as a privileged son of heaven. With such contrasting backgrounds, everyone anticipated Keira to be driven out, but instead, the tycoon said 'Darling, can we please not divorce?

Title: My Alpha Stepbrother
Synopsis: Twenty years ago the Lunaris Clan, its ancient inheritance coveted, wiped out the Hurst Clan's former Alpha and elders, and itself. Aged five, Jenny survived alone; her father sealed her bloodline and memories with the clan's secret art. Twenty years later Jenny, thinking herself human, is the Fated Mate the Moon Goddess chose for Ives, the Hurst clan's new Alpha. Two years ago Ives, of the Silver Wolf bloodline, provoked by her childhood friend Hengis, lost control on a full moon and spent three days and nights with Jenny, who then hid her scent and fled. They meet again as Jenny's mother Joanne weds Ives's father Jerrel. The Hurst clan rejects her humanity; Jenny, bent on avenging her father, spurns Ives, yet slowly faces her heart under his guidance. Then Hengis confesses; rejected, he is used by the Voss clan, where Maya would blame Ives for the murders. Playing along, they uncover the truth; Jenny inherits her clan's legacy, becoming Ives's powerful Luna.

Title: My Beast Is the 12-Winged Angel
Synopsis: Jiang Han crosses into a summoning realm, his top-tier Succubus instantly betraying him for a wealthy master. Undeterred, he bonds with a Broken-Winged Angel to public ridicule. Unknown to all, he holds a power to evolve his summon. When an Eight-Winged Seraph emerges, the world trembles.

Title: My beautiful wife
Synopsis: Caleb Stone, a rural divine doctor, cured folks and actually got a knockout wife as payback. He had hit the jackpot!

Title: My Beggar Husband Is Apollo
Tags: Back in Time; Revenge; Family; Baby; Mythology
Synopsis: Tiya, the unloved eldest daughter of House Antipater, is sold by her father and stepmother to a brutal lord. To escape, she publicly chooses a beggar—unaware he is Apollo in disguise. After one night, the god is forced back to Olympus, leaving Tiya to bear twins alone. For five years, she endures scorn and cruelty. When her stepmother offers the "monster-eyed" children as a sacrificial tribute, Tiya prays in desperation. Apollo returns in divine wrath—and everyone who wronged her will pay.

Title: My Bodyguard Owns Me Now
Synopsis: Four years saw Henry Smith, heir to M City’s richest family, plummet from privilege to a bar porter, while David, his once mistreated bodyguard, rose to become a brutal mafia leader.Vengeance consumed David. He crafted a trap of wealth and love, driving Henry to public ruin. But upon succeeding, David was hollow—he had grown genuine feelings for Henry in their contest.In his remorseful search, hidden truths emerged. Charles, long obsessed with Henry, killed David’s mother and destroyed the Smith fortune. Funds Henry secretly sent to aid David were intercepted by Charles via Ethan.Turning against the true villain, David realised he had wronged the love of his life. From hatred to deep love, he would devote his remaining years to earning a belated chance at happiness.

Title: My Bodyguard, My Lover
Synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, Hannah Grey discovers her fiancé's betrayal. Devastated, she finds solace in arms of her bodyguard, Matt Dawson—unaware he's a secret tycoon who has loved her for a decade. After a painful breakup, a fateful reunion five years later rekindles their fierce passion.

Title: My Boss Is My Secret Online Dom
Synopsis: Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious “Master,” whose commands make her feel safe.  But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her.  By day, they clash at the hospital.  By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only — “Cake.”  Enemies in real life. Addicted online.

Title: My Brothers’ Fifteen Winters of Regret
Synopsis: My brothers abandoned me on the night of my first shift.  For her. A sixteen-year-old Omega orphan named Ruby.  My Alpha brother, Sinclair, stole the Moon Essence our mother left me.  He gave it to her, to stabilize her wolf instead of mine.  When I begged them to help me, my Beta brother, Blake, roared at me to get out and never come back.  They ignored my pain and took that orphan girl to the healing sanctuary I had always dreamed of—Moon Goddess Falls.  So I accepted a different offer.  From the Werewolf High Council.  I became the Chief Runesmith, entering the "Crucible" Sanctum.  A position that requires fifteen years of secluded service.  Fifteen years of never going home.  By the time my brothers returned, I was already gone.  They say they’re frantic now. That they want me back.  Too bad. They're the ones who told me to leave.

Title: My Class. My Rules. My Revenge.
Synopsis: A former agent with telekinesis goes undercover as a high school teacher, crushing bullies and crime lords on his path to revenge—only to discover the mastermind who drove his daughter to death is his most gifted student: a born sociopath with a genius IQ. He doesn't want him dead. He wants him alive, rotting in a prison of the world's disgust.

Title: My Cultivator Secret Went Viral
Synopsis: Ye Fang, the only cultivator to reach Nascent Soul, last walked the mortal world in the Republican era. Foreseeing danger for his descendant, he returns to protect his family—and enjoy modern life. But his great-granddaughter, a livestreamer, accidentally exposes him.

Title: My Dad Is a Husky
Synopsis: Set in a quiet American suburban community, three years after his father Bill passed away, Jack adopts a husky named Max, only to shockingly find it holds Bill’s reincarnated soul. The sharp-tongued "dog dad" teases Jack, demands premium treats, and helps Jack pursue his neighbor Chloe. As Susan suspects the dog’s uncanny human habits, the secret is revealed, and the family reaches a warm, whimsical new balance. Mocked for awakening an obsolete F-rank Flame Card, Lucas Gray discovers that fire is humanity's only weapon against a global plant apocalypse. With gifted scout Lena Blue, he uncovers a sentient root network ruled by the Mother Plant. As cities fall, Lucas inherits the ancient Flame King power and leads humanity's counterattack. After Lena sacrifices herself, he awakens the mythic World-End Flame, destroys the World Tree and the Plant God, and gives civilization a chance to begin again.

Title: My Deadly Marriage with Ms. CEO
Synopsis: Forced into a cold political marriage, a wealthy heiress has a reckless one-night encounter with a hidden elite. A fake marriage forged by danger pulls them into a bloody battle among top families. Conspiracies, framing and brutal hunts unfold. The retired powerhouse strikes back, crushes the evil tycoon, and wins the heiress’s heart at last.

Title: My Dear Doctor, Please Be Gentle with Me
Synopsis: Coerced by her evil stepsister, a desperate girl spends one night with a cold wealthy doctor. Filled with misunderstandings, schemes and cruel bullying, love hides behind endless hardships. He chooses prison over a forced marriage. She arrives in a wedding dress, defends him in court, and marries him against all odds.

Title: My Double Proxy Marriage to a Billionaire
Tags: Baby; Hidden Identity; Family; Contract Marriage
Synopsis: Family outcast Ella Davenport's father arranges for her to marry a scumbag, but when she shows up to sign the papers, she realizes she's already married. And this mystery hubby isn't just anyone - it's smoking-hot CEO Cole McBride! Cole refuses to believe that they're really married, but with his aging grandmother taking an instant liking to Ella, getting rid of her might prove harder than he thought. Can this accidental couple take the unlikely path from mystery marriage to real love??

Title: My Empress and Dynamite Kiddo
Synopsis: A father of unmatched power raises his three-year-old twins into absolute monsters, but the kids have no clue how strong they really are. While he's in seclusion, they sneak out to the capital to find their missing mother, followed by a series of surprises.

Title: My Fiance is a Cannibal
Synopsis: In a modern American city, Voss is a celebrated pianist and composer adored by high society. Behind closed doors, he runs an invitation-only supper club—and is secretly a serial cannibal. Evelyn, blind since childhood, regains her sight after surgery. On the eve of her wedding, she discovers his horrifying secret and must keep pretending to be blind if she wants to stay alive.

Title: MY GIRLFRIEND'S LIKE A BROTOME
Synopsis: When farmhand Lane was tending to his cows, he accidentally triggered an ancient curse. His best friend Evan, who had come over to visit, transformed into a tall woman. Though Evan retained all his original memories and personality, an irresistible compulsion forced him to bear a child with Lane. Lane tried every means to evade her, yet Evan cut him off time and again. After a string of tangled confrontations, Evan fell pregnant and gave birth to an infant who wore Evan’s signature mischievous grin. The two were thus trapped in an eternally bound cycle of souls for all time.

Title: My Gorgeous Neighbor Is a Werewolf
Synopsis: Jack, a twenty-six-year-old low-level plumber, awakened the 'Blood Eye' system capable of perceiving hidden information in all things due to an accidental work injury. He discovered that his city was filled with supernatural beings such as werewolves and witches, and the beautiful neighbor he secretly admired, Luna, was actually an A-level werewolf being hunted by her family. To pay his rent and protect Luna, Jack used his Blood Eye ability to identify supernatural antiques, turning a five-dollar junk item into his first $300,000. As his abilities continued to unlock, he gained superhuman strength and was drawn into deeper whirlpools of events. When Luna’s S-level pursuer arrived in the city, Jack’s forbidden hybrid identity was exposed, attracting the hunting attention of the entire supernatural world. Jack must survive in dire circumstances, fight formidable enemies, and uncover the truth about his own origins.

Title: My Human Identity Was Exposed by an Evil Spirit Wife
Synopsis: Jiang Che is diagnosed with delusional disorder, always fantasizing about having a family, but is treated as mentally ill and locked up for ten years.  The bizarre descends upon the world, and he is pulled into an SSS-level dungeon labeled as unconquerable by humans.  When facing the terrifying and eerie spirits that scare everyone,  He hugs a loli with a severed limb, calling her his daughter,  Referring to the old bizarre spirits dressed in bloodstained nurse attire and holding a deadly Saw Meat Knife as his parents,  Facing the biggest boss of the SSS-level dungeon, he embraces it without hesitation and calls it his wife.

Title: My Husband Lost Me to His Uncle
Tags: Strong FL; Forbidden Love; Love Triangle; Face-slapping; Mafia
Synopsis: Waking from a car accident, heiress Seraphina Christie finds her fiance Tristan at her bedside — flaunting his pregnant mistress Arabella. To seize her fortune, Tristan fakes Seraphina's marriage to feared crime lord Cassius Sinclair, privately ordering him not to touch her. But Seraphina is only faking amnesia — and Cassius has seen through her from the start. As Arabella schemes to destroy Seraphina at every turn, Cassius's fierce protection and relentless seduction pull them closer. Arabella's final trap backfires catastrophically, her fake pregnancy is exposed, Tristan goes bankrupt, and Seraphina claims both revenge and Cassius.

Title: My Impotent Husband Cheats Every Day
Synopsis: Five years ago, washed-up actress Maeve married top attorney Dane, believing he was her savior. But during their marriage, he faked being impotent while cheating with his assistant. After Dane forces her to take a dangerous drug, she finally walks away for good. Then Nolan, the federal prosecutor who truly saved her years ago, returns. Dane is left drowning in regret— who will Maeve choose this time.

Title: My Kingdom Building Done Right!
Tags: Kingdom Building; The Chosen One; Comedy; System
Synopsis: Banished to the lawless frontier and left for dead, pampered noble Leone Frontera survives an absurd accident and is mistaken for the legendary Hero King by the remote Albolin Tribe. Armed with a mysterious kingdom-building system, a razor-tongued magical cat named Daedalus, and an increasingly bizarre band of loyal vassals, Leone must unite scattered tribes and build a nation from nothing. But rival clans, corrupted beasts, ancient magic, and armies gathering beneath a black sun threaten his fragile new kingdom. Leone may be vain, lazy, and wildly unprepared, but with outrageous luck, reckless schemes, and unexpected courage, he might just become the ruler everyone already believes he is.

Title: My Legal Lady
Synopsis: Two years ago, Belle was Zachary’s beloved. But a plot separated them. Two years later, she fought back, bumping into a hard and sticky“meat wall”... The man's voice is seductive: "Belle, you are mine!" A kid stretched out, "Who’s this bastard?" Zachary's ink eyes sank :" I’m your dad!"

Title: My Life for a False Luna
Tags: Werewolf; Revenge; All-Too-Late; Love Triangle; Family; Tragedy
Synopsis: The pack's healer diagnosed me with the Moonshadow Curse. I had three days to live. The only hope was a high-risk Blood Moon Ritual. But my Alpha mate, Ethan, gave the one chance for a cure to my adopted sister, Seraphina. He said she was more important to the pack. To appease my entire pack, I gave up the chance. I gave the runecraft workshop I had poured my heart and soul into, along with all its core design blueprints, to Seraphina. I agreed to sever our mate bond so he could bond with Seraphina. I even allowed my daughter, Chloe, to call Seraphina "mother." My pack, my mate, my daughter—they were all satisfied with my compliance. No one noticed the dark markings blooming on my skin, nor did they care about the blood I coughed up. They only accused me of playing the victim for attention. I just have one question. When they find my body, will they still be able to smile?

Title: My Mate's Father Wants Me
Synopsis: Elena, Luna of Crimson Hills Pack, is shattered by her mate Trent’s betrayal with her sister, then drawn into a dangerous, obsessive affair with his powerful father Vince—who orchestrates a scandal to ruin her reputation and force her into his control, as secrets, lies, and forbidden desire ignite a war between loyalty and lust.

Title: My Mechanic Prince
Synopsis: After her childhood sweetheart, Mullen, is killed saving her, Mia Reid agrees to a marriage of convenience to uncover the truth. But on the eve of her wedding, she encounters a mechanic with an altered memory—who is the supposedly dead Cyril Wilson, scion of the city's elite.

Title: My Pocket Leviathan
Tags: Strong FL; Forbidden Love; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Elara is an ordinary worker in a magical city, struggling to get by. Hoping for a little comfort, she buys a small black creature for just two copper coins, thinking it’s nothing more than a cute pet. But the creature is actually the Bone-Crowned Abyssal Beast, an ancient and feared Lord of the Abyss. From the shadows, it silently eliminates every danger around her, becoming an unseen guardian. Yet as others grow close to Elara, its jealousy begins to surface. To stay by her side, the beast takes human form—a dangerously attractive but obsessive man—willing to destroy anything that threatens her. The only risk is that Ella might discover the truth behind the “pet” who loves her too much.

Title: My Racing Nemesis Kissed Me
Tags: Hidden Feelings; Enemies to Lovers; BL; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Ethan, the navigator of the ESO racing team, and his arch-rival, the racer Lucas, are paired up as a new duo in the new season. Ethan is shocked to discover that his arch-rival actually has a secret crush on his sister. To ease their hostile relationship, the coach devises an intimate ice-breaking plan for them. However, during the process, Ethan is surprised to find that Lucas actually seems to like him.

Title: My Revenge Vacation
Tags: Strong FL; Forbidden Love; Revenge; All-Too-Late; Second Chance; Face-slapping; One Night Stand
Synopsis: Stuck together in mid-air! What happens when a betrayed Ballerina housewife swaps her husband's lube with SUPERGLUE? Betrayed by her husband and his late brother's widow, ballet prodigy Megan pulls off the most insane payback in high-altitude history. She replaces their lube with industrial superglue—trapping the naked cheaters glued together in an airplane bathroom at 30,000 feet for the whole world to see! When the furious ex tries to bankrupt her, enter Harrison: a powerful, icy billionaire uncle who has waited seven years to protect her. Together, they will make the cheating couple pay in blood and money!

Title: My Rich Wife
Synopsis: Ethan Smith never expected that three years of marriage would end with betrayal.

Title: My Ruthless Protector
Synopsis: "Young Luena falls into dire straits. Desperate to fund treatment for her critically ill mother, she applies for a high-paying assistant position and crosses paths with Zane, a man of commanding aura. The two clash constantly and butt heads repeatedly at first, yet Luena never compromises her dignity. As they spend more time together, Zane bends his rules for her time and again and quietly lends her a helping hand. They gradually grow closer, and romantic tension simmers between them.
