Title: Second Chance No More Mrs. Nice Girl
Tags: Rebirth; Face-slapping; Family; Forbidden Love; Revenge
Synopsis: After spending three years suffering as the unwanted “real daughter” of the Davis family, Chloe is drowned by her scheming adopted sister Mia—while her own family rushes past her to save the impostor. Reborn three years earlier, Chloe refuses to be the family doormat again. She cuts ties with the Davises, returns to the only man who ever truly loved her—her adoptive uncle Julian—and rises as a genius hacker, prodigy designer, and the heiress they will all beg to win back.

Title: Secret Love：My Swimming God Stepbrother
Tags: Hidden Feelings; Forbidden Love; BL; Campus; Sports
Synopsis: Transfer student Noah works part-time to cover his mother’s medical bills. He has an unexpected one-night encounter with Ethan, a swimming prodigy and wealthy heir, only to discover they are stepbrothers by law. Trapped under the exploitation of his stepfather Victor, Noah nearly gets sold to a pervert, but Ethan steps in to shield him. As they train side by side, tender feelings bloom between them. Teammate Caleb and rival Eric repeatedly scheme to torment and harm them, while Victor’s constant violence wrecks their lives. Breaking free from his miserable family, Noah competes in the national swimming championship, chasing his dream despite all wounds. Ethan casts aside worries about his status and stands firmly by his side. Surmounting blood ties, class divides and endless malice, they embrace a gentle future only theirs, amid swimming pools and ordinary warm days.

Title: Secret Marriage with a Tycoon Husband
Synopsis: Benny Sorg could never have imagined that she would randomly marry a "driver," only to discover that the person she had married was none other than the powerful heir of the Lovell Group, Hardin Lovell. What will happen between them?

Title: Seduced by my boyfriend's uncle
Synopsis: After a tragic accident leaves genius musician Ciel Frost blind, he survives his darkest days through the fierce, suffocating love of brilliant director Marco Kingsley. But a carefully planned conspiracy tears them apart. When Ciel regains his sight, he is trapped by lies and mistakes Marco’s scheming nephew, Liam, for the man who once saved him.  Three years later, Marco returns as a ruthless billionaire mogul. Concealing his identity as the project’s largest investor and the powerful Kingsley patriarch, he forces his way back into Ciel’s life. As that familiar, dangerous presence closes in, burning touches awaken memories Ciel thought were lost. The truth destroys every lie: Marco was his true savior, while Liam had stolen his place.  Exposed at last, Liam pays a devastating price, left ruined and disgraced. Drawn together by a love neither time nor betrayal could erase, Marco and Ciel overcome every obstacle and finally fall into each other’s arms again.

Title: Seducing My Dad’s Best Friend.
Synopsis: A forbidden, steamy romance between a young woman and her father’s best friend—where desire, secrets, and obsession collide.

Title: Seductive Security
Synopsis: With his master taking off with the money, Carson storms down the mountain to find his fiancée, only to be whisked away by a woman on the road to play the part of her fake boyfriend. And to top it off? She's a dead ringer for his fiancée!

Title: She Becomes Glamorous After The Engagement Annulment
Synopsis: After being abandoned by her fiancé, Nancy Sue, who was overweight and considered unattractive, became the subject of ridicule throughout the city.  Years later, Nancy successfully transformed herself, shedding a hundred pounds. Intrigued by her newfound beauty, her former fiancé returned with a bouquet of flowers in hand, expressing, "Nancy, I made a mistake. I am willing to do anything to win you back."

Title: Silent Rose: His Kneeling for Love
Synopsis: After a car crash, Claire loses her voice. Her husband Oliver wants a fake divorce to please his mistress, but she takes it seriously. Ethan, heir to Conley Group, flies back to propose. Claire leaves gracefully, leaving Oliver drowned in regret.

Title: Silent Wife,Deadly Revenge
Synopsis: Mute heiress Ava Sinclair overhears her husband Ethan plotting to kill her or have her declared insane to seize her trust fund and company voting rights. Trapped during a hurricane with no phone, she flees through hidden passages. She discovers Ethan is a cleaner for Vesper, a criminal syndicate involved in trafficking and laundering. With FBI agent Alex Reed, she retrieves evidence from her father's secret Black Archive. They fake her death to escape Vesper's leader Grant Vale. After freezing Ethan's assets, Ethan takes Nora hostage. Ava triggers her father's dead-man switch, uploading the entire archive to the FBI, media, and the trust administrator. Ethan is arrested, and Ava reclaims her company. In the end, she signs: 'My silence was never weakness.'

Title: Sinbound: Claimed by the Mother of Night
Tags: Forbidden Love; Love Triangle; One Night Stand; R18
Synopsis: Catching her fiancé cheating on the night of their would-be engagement was a nightmare. Seeking revenge by falling into bed with his billionaire mother? That was the real scandal. But Tessa soon discovers her new lover isn’t just her would-be-mother-in-law. Layla is Lilith, the ancient Mother of Demons. When Max tries to drag Tessa back, he’s about to learn that the real monster wears a bespoke suit... and has wings.

Title: Single mother Jasmine Yale
Synopsis: For Sylvan Cheney, Jasmine Yale is the only woman he loved; And for Jasmine Yale, Sylvan Cheney is the light of her whole youth. Until that day Jasmine was wheeled into the operating room, helplessly watching her child...

Title: Slaying Monsters at Bureau 749
Synopsis: Jiang Zhan, a chosen Natural Awakener, encountered the inner-world monster "Road Wraith's Maw" during his internship, activating his golden finger — the "Shadow Monarch" ability. Killing monsters became his sole path to advancement. Extreme and decisive, he earned the title "Bone Withering Death Star."  He joined Bureau 749, a special agency containing supernatural monsters, and partnered with investigator Chen Ziyi. Together they handled bizarre cases like the "Killer Love Letters" and battled monster forces orchestrated by the Heaven Slaughter Alliance and wealthy heir Zhou Heng, gradually unraveling the tangled mystery between the Surface World and the Inner World.  Believing in "proving one's path through slaughter," he disregarded rules, blood-washed corruption, and used extreme methods to reshape order. Amid the contradiction between containment and killing, he carved out his own "bright and just world" through the blade.

Title: Slime Evolution
Tags: Inhuman MC; Adventure; Weak to Strong; Evolution; Game; Comedy
Synopsis: Lohan, a down-and-out young man buried under heavy debts, turned his life around thanks to the holographic game Elysium. He accidentally bonded with a rare mythic slime with the devour ability. All abilities he gained in the game were mirrored into the real world. Lohan grew powerful fast with his Devour Talent: slaying monsters, spawning clones and mastering magic. With all he got he expanded their guild, confronted the hidden corporate forces behind everything, and rose step by step to rewrite his fate.

Title: Soggy Affection
Synopsis: "Alicia, the most unassuming bookworm on campus, wears black-rimmed glasses and gray hoodies. For three years, Leon, the school heartthrob, has never spared her a glance. He even splashed water on her friend in public, sneering that “bookworms have no personality.”  Everything changes at an extravagant masquerade ball. Alicia dons a black lace mask and a red sequin gown, stepping into Leon’s line of sight as an enigmatic beauty. After a night of unrestrained intimacy, she removes her mask before him, announcing it is a meticulously plotted revenge.  Yet Leon does not storm off in anger. Instead, he clumsily sets out to win her over: learning to cook noodles for her, fixing her bookshelf, and teaching her how to fight. As campus rumors, provocation from exes, and a falling-out with her best friend crash down on them, the pair whose connection began with pretense must decide if they dare to love each other for who they truly are.

Title: Soul Pawnshop: Midnight Redemption
Synopsis: At midnight in New York, a strange pawnshop materializes, trading only soul fragments. Its immortal owner Kane bears a thousand-year curse, guarding interworld balance yet tormented by broken memories. Bold detective Leah investigates odd vanishings and stumbles into his forbidden realm—she alone holds a pure soul able to undo his curse’s seal. Dark overlord invades to steal the Contract Stone and remake reality. Kane and Leah forge a shaky alliance, fighting deadly battles together. Linked by soul resonance and fate, they uncover the truth behind Kane’s curse, forming a timeless bond as they save humanity and keep a millennium-old vow.

Title: Spotlight on Our Secret
Synopsis: After reporter Aubree Young’s flash marriage to superstar Reuben Chambers, he publicly announces their union, shocking the entertainment world. Her half-sister claims to be the real Mrs. Movie Star and bullies Aubree at work. To protect Reuben’s career, Aubree keeps their marriage hidden until she learns he has a crush.

Title: Stand-in Bride Schooled Her Husband
Synopsis: Miss Sanchez got a second shot at life and reborn as Anthea Sanchez. She was forced to take Alma's place and marry Zeke as a stand-in bride. This time, as a master fighter, a master healer, a top hacker and a violin genius, Anthea doesn't play around.

Title: Starting Over, I Married the Scumbag's Boss
Synopsis: In her past life, the innocent Lucy was betrayed and killed by her scumbag boyfriend and cousin. Having been reborn, she vowed to take her revenge. This time, she teamed up with her ex-boyfriend's boss to bring the scumbag to justice. Together, they lived a happy life.

Title: Still Not a Doll Today
Synopsis: In this animated survival thriller, the entire world is transformed into a series of deadly game maps, and one player after another is turned into a doll.  At the center of the story is Bai Youwei, a seemingly frail young woman whose helpless appearance conceals a brilliant and calculating mind. She teams up with Shen Mo, a handsome and formidable fighter with unmatched combat skills.  Combining her intelligence with his strength, the pair battle their way through one deadly challenge after another, repeatedly outsmarting the Puppet Games and emerging victorious.

Title: Stitching Together Our Fate
Synopsis: Claire Morgan rescues and operates on the severely injured Ethan Walker in the countryside, then leaves before he sees her face. Later, bound by her grandfather’s arrangement, she enters a 100-day marriage contract with the Walker family—only to discover her groom is the man she saved.

Title: Stop Searching, Mr. Knight—Your Wife Is Right Here
Tags: Hidden Identity; Baby; Revenge; Face-slapping; Rebirth
Synopsis: Five years ago, Morgan Knight’s wife left him a dragon egg and said, “This is the son I bore for you. When Little Niall grows up, I will return.” Morgan thought she was joking—until a baby dragon hatched from the egg several months later. After his wife disappeared, Morgan spent five agonizing years searching for her. Then one day, Little Niall brings home Seraphina Sterling, the outcast daughter of the Somerset family. “Dad, you may not have a wife,” the boy announces, “but you’re about to have a daughter-in-law! She saved me, so I’m going to marry her!” Morgan immediately snaps out of his despair. From then on, father and son become fierce rivals, openly and secretly competing for Seraphina’s affection. Seraphina plans to win over the powerful father and son and rely on their protection to avenge her mother. What she never expects is that one of them is actually her husband—and the other is her biological son.

Title: Strongest Superhuman System
Synopsis: Mark was just an average Superhuman living in the City. His daily routine was skipping classes and hanging out with his only friend while hunting for Anima in secret whenever he could. But this easy life was not going to last for long as the hidden power he sacrificed a long time ago began to awaken once more!

Title: Summoners Are Weak? I Gain a Golden Affix Every Level
Synopsis: The Abyss descends and the Outer Gods invade. In an age when everyone awakens a class, Shen Fei becomes a Summoner—the most expensive and resource-hungry class of all. His family immediately turns against him, casts him out, and waits for him to fall into ruin. What they do not know is that Shen Fei has actually awakened the Mythic Affix System, which can transform ordinary Summoned Beasts into gods. After his palm-sized Azure Phoenix hatchling receives the Devour affix, it can not only kill powerful monsters in an instant but also refine their remains into priceless treasures. Look down on him? He proves them wrong on the spot. Short on resources? He makes his own fortune. His journey begins with a tiny Azure Phoenix—and leads toward a Kunpeng capable of devouring all things.

Title: Super Divine Eyes
Synopsis: Skye Zale is an ordinary taxi driver who, after accidentally helping a drunken beauty, discovers that he has gained a miraculous ability.

Title: Super Insane Doctor of the Goddess
Tags: Miracle Doctor; Inhuman MC; Counterattack; Cultivation
Synopsis: Not a dragon unless it crosses the river, not a tiger unless it descends the mountain. Following his master's orders, Lionel Yeager descends from the mountain and ventures into the bustling city. With extraordinary medical skills, unparalleled immortal techniques, Lionel transcends life and death, defies yin and yang, commands the universe, and sweeps away enemies coming his way—he aims to conquer the pinnacle of the world!

Title: Supreme Doctor
Synopsis: Tony Gray was jailed three years for his wife. After he was released, he found himself betrayed by his wife. As a bless, however, he elevated his power and stepped into the world of immortal realms.

Title: Sweet Vengeance in His Arms
Synopsis: Framed repeatedly for lacking her sister’s acting skills, Chloe Moore becomes the ultimate scapegoat. To escape her toxic family, she wishes to marry her parents’ enemy and it comes true. Being their daughter was miserable, but being their enemy’s wife becomes surprisingly addictive and empowering.

Title: Sword Immortal
Tags: Xianxia; Game; Weak to Strong; Cultivation; Game Transmigration
Synopsis: In 2155, Lin Zhao's dying mind is uploaded into the game The World. Chosen by an ancient sword, he rises from crippled outcast to sword prodigy, leading humanity against demon hordes, only to uncover the truth linking game and reality.

Title: System Error: The Villain Respawned in My Bed!
Synopsis: Vivian, an overworked New York office worker, is obsessed with an otome game and determined to save its tragic villain, Grand Duke Karen, from his doomed fate.  When a glitch triggers a dimensional rift, Karen crosses into the real world—wounded, possessive, and dangerously devoted. He sees Vivian as his goddess and becomes fiercely attached to her, refusing to leave her side.  As he adapts to modern life and even rises in influence on Wall Street, it becomes clear the rift is not accidental. Dark forces begin seeping into reality, and the game’s heroes arrive to hunt him down.  To protect him from being erased, Vivian defies fate itself, choosing to stand against the world to save the villain she refuses to lose.

Title: System Lover Taming the Demon Lord
Synopsis: "Modern girl Lily accidentally transmigrates into a novel and binds herself to a villain-captivation system. Her mission is to win over Kael, the feared maniac Demon Lord, whose initial favorability rating starts at rock-bottom negative values.  She takes an unconventional approach. Through silly antics and heartfelt companionship, she gradually thaws the Demon Lord’s frozen heart, and the two grow fond of each other as they spend time together. Later, Lily uncovers a hidden conspiracy behind the system and the Inter-World Bureau; its true goal is to force her to kill the Demon Lord.  The pair resolve to join forces and rebel against the scriptwriter overlord who controls everything. After revelations of true identities and life-or-death choices, they shatter the rules of this world. In the end, Lily returns to reality with her memories erased, while the Demon Lord crosses dimensions to seek her love once more in her world."

Title: Tamed by Sweet Kisses
Tags: Revenge; Rebirth; Hidden Identity; Second Chance
Synopsis: In her previous life, Jade was murdered by her husband, Leo Vance, and her scumbag father’s illegitimate daughter. She is reborn on the very night she was drugged and became entangled with Master Sterling. Suffering from an olfactory disorder, Master Sterling finds his condition improving around her, so he poses as a male model to stay by her side. Focused on revenge, Jade nevertheless keeps finding herself protecting and caring for him. As they test each other and eventually join forces, they expose every enemy’s scheme and bring all those who wronged them to justice. In the end, Master Sterling reveals his elite identity, offers her his entire fortune, and proposes to marry into her family. At last, they find their happy ending.

Title: Taming the beastworld with my baby system
Tags: Reverse Harem; Dragon King; Beast; R18; System; Suspense
Synopsis: Roxy was frantically chased by a giant mutated wild boar in the otherworldly forest, driven to the brink of desperation. In this critical moment, the "Procreate & Offspring System" forcefully bound to her, informing her of the world's curse and issuing a deadly, urgent quest: [Mate with a high-rank bloodline and become pregnant within 8 hours, or the Host will be eliminated.] To escape the boar and follow the system's guidance to find a "suitable mate," Roxy hid inside a massive underground cave overflowing with priceless gems.  Megalophobia and Target Lock: Roxy was shocked to discover that slumbering in this cave was not an ordinary beast, but a colossal obsidian dragon. The system ruthlessly locked onto this "Dragon King" as the primary Tier 1 mating target. Caught between the threat of death and the fear of being eaten by the dragon, Roxy was forced to approach the sleeping behemoth.

Title: Tangled in desire
Tags: Forbidden Love; R18; Campus; Academy; Sweet Love; Hidden Feelings
Synopsis: Elena is a girl from the slums who nearly dropped out of school because she couldn't afford tuition. She was sponsored by the wealthy Arthur, eventually completed her education, and became a university lecturer. She works at the same school as Arthur's stepson Julian, but Elena has no idea that her benefactor's son is actually her own student. During Julian's three years of extreme survival, Elena agreed to marry the middle-aged Arthur out of gratitude, becoming Julian's stepmother. Arthur also doesn't know that Elena was Julian's teacher three years ago. When Julian returns three years later, Arthur hopes his stepson and wife can get along peacefully, so he arranges for Elena to become Julian's private tutor. Upon returning, Julian discovers that the teacher he secretly loved has become his stepmother. He can't accept it, yet he can't control his heart.

Title: Tangled in Midnight
Synopsis: After losing both parents, Lila Hart is taken in by the Keatons, whom her father served before he died. An unexpected night with Nate Keaton, their second son, feels like a moment of weakness until she realizes he planned it from the start.

Title: Tangled in Moonlight: Unshifted
Tags: Werewolf; Second Chance; Weak to Strong; R18; Strong FL; Hidden Identity
Synopsis: Ava Grey is the pack defect, a wolfless shifter, constantly bullied and harassed. Her opportunity comes when she finds out she'll be attending the Moonlight Gala, an annual ball for young adult shifters to find their fated mate. Whether it's fate or luck, Ava meets Lucas Westwood, the Alpha of rival pack at the ball, and finds out he is her fated mate. Their attraction is beautiful and intense and Ava thinks her life might finally change... until he rejects her.

Title: Taste Me, Claim Me, My Four Bad Alphas
Tags: Werewolf; Beloved by All; Reverse Harem; R18; Rebirth
Synopsis: Lyre, heiress of the top Alpha family, is framed by her stepsister Sabrina as wanton and loose, turning her four elite werewolf suitors—Alpha King Cassian, childhood fiancé Ronan, professor Julian, and adopted prodigy Elias—against her. She dies alone in a fire. Reborn at the very moment her simultaneous flirtations are exposed and she is scorned, she coldly withdraws. But the four men who once rejected her now close in obsessively—why did she start this game, yet refuse to be claimed by any of them?

Title: Tears of Regrets
Synopsis: Wania Jennings married Benjamin Zacker whom she never met. After two years, Benjamin's grandfather was sent to the emergency room and she found out he'd been taking care of Yasmin who was ill. Then, Wania decided to divorce him without telling him her identity. But gradually, he figured it out.

Title: Tease me, My step Brother
Synopsis: "Damien Black wasn’t a regular man, he was one of the most popular billionaires in the world and the youngest. Known for his cruel, and play boy characteristics.   what happens when their one night stand brings forth fruit?  What happens when he get to fall in love with the girl he hate creating what would be called a forbidden romance between them.  What happens when she discovers that she is pregnant for her brother when is married to her husband."

Title: Ten Days to Live: My Husband Regrets
Tags: Strong FL; All-Too-Late; Second Chance; Abusive Love
Synopsis: Blind designer Evelyn sacrificed everything for her husband Jasper—her corneas, her blood, her dreams—only to discover his affair with his assistant Lilith when she has just ten days left to live. After being drained of her last worth, Evelyn signs a body donation form and dies quietly. Jasper regrets too late...

Title: The Academy’s Most Wanted Omega
Synopsis: "This is a dark fantasy romance set in a wolf-shifter realm of Alphas, Omegas, and royal politics. Chloe Rainehart, a quiet Omega, has spent three years trapped in a loveless royal marriage to Jordan Halecrest, the future Sovereign Alpha. Married only to stabilize his political image while he remains loyal to his first love, Mira, Chloe is ignored, neglected, and reduced to a convenient shield. When she finally demands a divorce, she does the unthinkable: she severs their fated mate bond—a act believed impossible for an Omega—and walks away."

Title: The Alpha Who Watched in Silence
Synopsis: Five years ago, my ex-mate rejected me before the entire pack. He chose his childhood sweetheart, who carried another man’s pup. Now, I'm back. And he was the one dispatched to greet me. "Look at you," he stared at the necklace on my neck. "Still so desperate for attention you'd wear a cheap knock-off like that." My fingers grazed the cool diamonds. The idiot had no idea. This necklace was a gift from my Alpha. And of all his gifts, this was the very least.

Title: THE ALPHA'S VIRGIN SLAVE
Synopsis: Amelia, a helpless omega from a conquered pack, is horrified to discover that the ruthless, cruel alpha Ian—who destroys packs and shares his mate with his pack—is her fated mate, trapping her in a world of violence, possession, and forbidden longing.

Title: The Alpha’s Unwanted Bride
Synopsis: Jasmine is the first daughter of the great Alpha Bale.  Because of her status as a bastard child, she lives a life maltreated scrubbing floors and attending to the needs of her father, step mother, step siblings and the entire pack.  But her life makes a drastic turn when she is switched in place for her father’s legitimate daughter to be married off to the Handsome and Cold hearted Alpha Xaden.

Title: The Anomaly Emperor and His Adorable Wife
Tags: System; Inhuman MC; Rebirth; Hidden Identity; Streaming; Horror
Synopsis: Ten years into the Anomalies Resurgence, the "Matchmaking System" was created. Dragon Nation’s top beauty, Yun Zhenyue, chose Gu Yuan, a powerless anomaly, to be her partner. Actually Gu was the Supreme Emperor. Under his protection, Yun cleared every level like a walk in the park. Dragon Nation finally reclaimed its throne.

Title: The Ascent Prey and Predator
Synopsis: Chloe, a wealthy heiress, once kept Liam as her lover before casting him aside three years later. Unexpectedly, her family’s conglomerate suddenly plunged into a devastating crisis. Her father fell critically ill, and the company went bankrupt, sending Chloe crashing from the pinnacle of luxury to rock bottom overnight.  Three years later, desperate to raise money for her father’s medical bills, Chloe takes a job at Shengshi Group under an assumed name—only to discover that the group’s CEO is none other than Liam, the man she abandoned years ago. Gone is the docile Liam she once knew; he has turned cold, ruthless and unforgiving. He exacts revenge on Chloe by forcing her to sign an oppressive contract as his personal secretary, subjecting her to endless humiliation and harsh mistreatment.

Title: The Bastard Hero
Synopsis: Lukas Belmont, waking up as the powerless, orphaned ward in a house of super-powered heroes, awakened with a system but his stats are still garbage. His only path to power is the Scumbag System which request him complete the "humiliating" quests. And so on, his first quest's to smack the ass of Sloane Fitzgerald—his fiery, super-powered psuedo-sister who sees him as a brother and a pervert in equal measure, and the penalty for failure is the reduction of his manhood permanently. Watch and see if an insect with a gacha system really can climb a ladder built for gods or not.

Title: The Beast's Exclusive Medicine
Synopsis: Alexander, a tycoon and group CEO, has a unique physical condition that makes him repelled by all perfumes—yet he feels no aversion whatsoever to the natural scent of Chloe, a rookie actress. After a chance encounter, he deems Chloe his exclusive antidote. He boldly paves the way for her career, signing her onto top-tier resources and overriding all objections to cast her as the leading lady.  Faced with public skepticism and malicious sabotage from fellow entertainers, Alexander fiercely defends her, clearing every obstacle in her path. Chloe gradually shifts from passive reliance to genuine affection for him. They redeem and grow alongside each other as they stand by one another through every trial.  This story conveys positive values of mutual protection, emotional healing and joint progress. It depicts the sincere, devoted love between two powerful individuals who cherish only each other and stride hand in hand toward a shared future.

Title: The Beastbind
Tags: Beloved by All; Revenge; Power Couple
Synopsis: Talia Greenwood, a master beast tamer, loses everything when her husband betrays her. Starting over at a failing menagerie, she captures the attention of Gerard, a mysterious buyer who is secretly the crown prince. Together they expose corruption, win a national competition, and fall in love. When Gerard’s true identity and a forced royal engagement are revealed, Talia storms the wedding with an army of magical beasts. She proves her worth to the king, foils a deadly plot, and becomes Crown Princess, forging a legendary beast legion.

Title: The Billionaire CEO’s Love & Revenge
Synopsis: This is a dark, emotional story of love, betrayal, revenge, and redemption—where two broken souls must confront their pain before it destroys them both.

Title: The Billionaire Falls for Me
Synopsis: Lila, who has loved Silas Voss wholeheartedly for three years, is framed by his childhood sweetheart Marina, loses her family, unborn child, and voice, and is humiliated, imprisoned, and sold at auction—all while Silas remains blind to the truth and treats her as his enemy.

Title: The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl
Synopsis: After a one-night-stand, Adele Moore becomespregnant. She wants to keep the child, but herfather kicks her out of the house. With nowhereelse to go,Adele becomes homeless. She triesher best to raise her son despite her challengingcircumstances.One day, Adele's son, BradMoore, runs into billionaire Heston Deleon. Bychance,Heston discovers that Brad is his son. Hetries to track down Brad, but loses their trail.Through a series of misunderstandings, Adeleand Heston become entangled again!

Title: The Billionaire Twins Need A New Mommy!
Tags: Power Couple; Strong FL; Baby; Hidden Identity; Comedy
Synopsis: Reborn and mysteriously pregnant, Lola loses her child in a car accident. Five years later, she returns to Novera as "Taz," bent on reclaiming her mother's inheritance and destroying the Young family and Melissa. Genius twins Chacha and Second recognize her as their mother, triggering comedic chaos. Lola exposes the Youngs publicly. Atlas — her high school first love — appears in a fish-head mask, and the twins force them into cohabitation. As romance ignites, Lola rebuilds her career and backs actor Cedrick. Through Hudson, she learns she entered the wrong room the night everything went wrong — and photos confirm Atlas was the man in Room 309. Atlas exhumes the child's grave: the remains belong to neither of them. Her real child may be alive. When Vito resurfaces, Lola claims Chacha and Second: "I want them." Atlas confirms the twins are likely theirs — but Vito echoes her words with a chilling threat, setting up Season 2.

Title: The Billionaire's Betrayal
Synopsis: Born into a wealthy family, she should've had a blissful marriage, but due to her sister's schemes, her love misunderstood and humiliated her, and her wicked sister even went as far as trying to murder her. In her darkest hour, her real family came to her rescue...

Title: THE BILLIONAIRE'S BROKEN BRIDE
Synopsis: To secure his family’s fortune and CEO title, Fredric enters a loveless, fake marriage with the kind but timid Mathilda—all while continuing his secret affair with his glamorous lover Paula, leaving Mathilda trapped in humiliation, longing, and a cruel web of lies.

Title: The Billionaire's Hidden Quadruplet
Synopsis: Amanda, a hardworking single mother raising quadruplets alone after a traumatic one-night stand, is betrayed by her fake friend Mabel—who steals the stranger’s luxury watch and pretends to be the night’s mystery woman to live a billionaire’s lavish life—while Amanda unknowingly crosses paths again with the children’s cold, powerful father, Rowan Xi.

Title: The Billionaire's Sweetheart: A Second Chance
Synopsis: Amidst lies and schemes, Dylan wins Carla back.

Title: The Billionaire’s Betrayed Love
Synopsis: Three years ago, Alma was framed by her stepsister Linda into a scandal with Linda’s fiancé Carl, forcing them into a secret contract marriage. On their third anniversary, Alma, hiding her pregnancy, rushes to surprise Carl—only to be met with a cold divorce demand: Carl still loves Linda, who’s returned, and blames Alma for drugging him. Heartbroken, Alma begs him to believe she was framed, but Carl fires her, rejects her, and abandons her, leaving her shattered with their unborn child.

Title: The Bodyguard
Synopsis: "Late one night, Chloe, the owner of a dessert shop, is cornered by a gang of thugs. Kane, a muscular man, comes to her rescue out of nowhere. Yet despite his imposing build, he is shy as a golden retriever and mentions he knows how to make red bean soup. Mistaking him for an applicant for a dessert apprentice position, Chloe hires him on the spot. In truth, Kane is a bodyguard sent by the underworld to protect her. Clumsy as he is, he unexpectedly bakes delicious cakes. Their romance blossoms amid sweet everyday moments — constant food treats, an embrace during a power outage, and the strawberry-patterned apron. When Chloe gets kidnapped, Kane reveals his true identity and brings her back covered in blood. Far from being terrified, she asks him to teach her how to fight. After her father is attacked, the soft, sweet Chloe transforms into a female underworld boss. Together with Kane, she takes down the mastermind Vincent and restructures the gang into a chain of dessert shops.

Title: The Bodyguard She Can't Resist
Synopsis: Shawn Lynn is just a nobody guard until he ticks off a billionaire heiress. Now she's tailing him, rich suitors are threatening him, and keeping his real identity under wraps is getting dangerously hard.

Title: The Boss Mom Doesn't Want to Work Anymore
Synopsis: After being dumped, Ruby Smith gave up on herself. At Madam Clark’s birthday party, she surprised everyone by presenting Madam Clark’s adorable grandson. Brought back into the Clark family, Ruby just wanted to slack off, but ridicule pushed her to reveal her hidden talents in every field.

Title: The Boss Wants Her and Her Son
Synopsis: At 18, Iris Stone was framed by her stepmother and stepsister, her reputation ruined. Seven years later, she returns with her little prodigy son, ready for revenge! At a high-society event, she meets the legendary cold and untouchable Jude Monroe. He corners her against a wall. “Woman, I want you.”

Title: The Boss's Jealousy
Tags: Baby; Hidden Identity; Family; Contract Marriage
Synopsis: Yadiel's grandmother urged him to see an andrologist due to his long-term single status. Surprisingly, his doctor was Shaylee, whom he had secretly admired. Knowing she was single, Yadiel signed a six-month marriage contract with her on the blind date he set up. Meanwhile, Shaylee's ex-boyfriend tried to reconcile, but she declined.

Title: The Bride Who Borrowed a Name
Tags: Revenge; Contract Marriage; Hidden Identity; Superpowers
Synopsis: Mistreated Cinderella Joyce replaces her sister to marry Landon, the billionaire heir. Awakening a legendary nature magic, she activates his family’s ancient power. When her cruel stepfamily tries to sabotage her at the banquet, Joyce shuts them down and claims her rightful place as the supreme matriarch!

Title: The Butler's Gambit
Synopsis: Disguised as head butler “Ryan Cole,” Lian Hale infiltrates Voss Manor to exact a 20-year vengeance against Selan Voss, the ruthless patriarch who seduced Lian's mother and drove his father to suicide. Lian methodically destroys the family from within: he stokes conflicts between Selan and his ambitious wife Grace, and manipulates their daughter Elena by exploiting a forgotten childhood bond.  However, the perceptive Selan is already suspicious of his flawlessly competent new butler. The manor becomes a deadly minefield of hidden traps where one misstep could expose Lian’s true identity. As the line between calculated manipulation and genuine affection for Elena begins to blur, Lian’s master plan is jeopardized. Will his mask slip before his vengeance is realized? Or will Elena, intended to be his ultimate pawn, become the one variable that changes everything?

Title: The CEO Who Took Me Home
Synopsis: Calvin Lowe sets out to find his arranged fiancée as his master instructed. But a CEO drags him into pretending to be her boyfriend. She looks just like his fiancée. His simple mission spirals into chaos and unexpected romance.

Title: The Cripple Who Claimed a Principessa
Tags: Strong FL; Love Triangle; Face-slapping; Mafia
Synopsis: Before my wedding to Julian Griffin, he crossed out his own name on the marriage contract and signed his brother's, Rhys Griffin's, instead. All for a stupid bet with Amber Cross.   The marriage contract was a sacred symbol of our bond. Yet, Julian treated such a solemn  vow like a cheap joke.   On the wedding day, Julian arrived at the church to find it uttutterly deserted. He called me. I stood before my new groom and answered calmly, "Are you calling to offer your congratulations?"

Title: The Cursed Luna’s Last Breath
Synopsis: I'm cursed with Blood Rot, and my days are numbered. I didn't want to leave with any regrets, so I traveled alone to Laurel Bay, a place I had always longed to visit. I didn't tell anyone I planned to end my life there. I just never expected to run into my former mate. We hadn't seen each other in ten years. He wore another she-wolf's bonding token, and the photo on his phone was of their pup. We were exchanging strained pleasantries when he suddenly asked, "Do you still hate me, Celeste?"

Title: The Dead Husband Who Never Died
Synopsis: On Thanksgiving, I saw a post on Reddit. "What's the most romantic thing your partner has ever done for you?" The comments section flooded, with users sharing intimate stories from their love lives. Some said it was a bowl of hot soup at three in the morning; others said it was their partner quitting a ten-year smoking habit.

Title: The Defender Next to Her
Synopsis: Charlie Lowe, a young man from the countryside, is sent down the mountain by his master to find his fiancée, Julia Cook. He gets caught up in a high-society feud because of the mystery of Divine Pendant and ends up protecting Julia as her contract husband.

Title: The Devil CEO's Contract Wife
Tags: Office; Contract Marriage; Sweet Love; Mafia
Synopsis: After three years working for the ruthless “Devil CEO” Ares King, Catherine Lane agrees to become his contract wife for one year in exchange for enough money to save her family’s farm. The only rule: she must never fall in love with him. But as their fake marriage turns dangerously real, Catherine is pulled into Ares’s dark family empire—and discovers that his family may be responsible for her parents’ deaths. Five years later, she returns with a daughter, a new identity, and unfinished business.

Title: The Devil's Contract
Tags: Second Chance; Forbidden Love; Flash Marriage
Synopsis: "On the eve of her wedding, Leah catches her fiancé cheating with his adopted sister. Drunk and distraught at a bar, she spends the night entangled with a mysterious stranger. The next day at the church, her fiancé abandons her to attend to his supposedly ill adopted sister. Her adoptive parents publicly berate her as worthless trash.    Just as Leah sinks into despair, the church doors fly open. The woman from the previous night strides forward against the backlight, her red-soled high heels shattering the silence of the entire venue. She is Zara Carrington, her fiancé’s stepmother and the legendary matriarch who holds power over the whole family. Zara takes Leah’s hand and stands in place of the groom to complete the wedding ceremony."

Title: The Don's Obsession
Tags: R18; Mafia; BL; Abusive Love; Enemies to Lovers
Synopsis: Mixed-race college student Elias is cornered by loan sharks after his father flees the country with millions. Then Lucius Vance, the iron-fisted don of the Vance family, descends. He forces Elias to sign a contract—not as an assistant, but as his personal plaything. He shoots through the hand of anyone who covets Elias, and shatters his will in a dark wine cellar. Elias never fully surrenders. On a yacht under enemy fire, he makes a run for a lifeboat—but it was a game all along. Lucius catches him in the rain. Enraged by his defiance, he binds Elias's wrists to the bed with his own belt. With absolute power and a branding mark, Lucius declares one thing: this forbidden contract has no escape. Not anymore.

Title: The Dragonborn Saga: Blood Reforged
Tags: Inhuman MC; Counterattack; Weak to Strong; Cultivation
Synopsis: After his Primal Vein is stolen, young Brycen Ewing is left powerless and broken. But when he unexpectedly obtains the Supreme Sanctum, he rebuilds himself from nothing, conquers every cultivation technique, and ascends to stand at the absolute pinnacle, becoming an unmatched sovereign of limitless power.

Title: The Duke's Forbidden Wet Nurse
Tags: Empress; Baby; Revenge; One Night Stand; Hidden Identity; Royalty
Synopsis: Three years ago, heiress Isabella was framed by her stepfamily and fled. She met Duke Adrian, whose nightmares only she could calm. Ten months later, after giving birth to Leo, her stepsister Selena stole the baby, faked his death, and pushed Isabella off a cliff.  Isabella survived, changed her look, and returned as Bella, Leo’s wet nurse. Her scent still soothed Adrian. She signed a contract with him to uncover the truth and stay near her son, and love grew between them.  Soon Selena’s lie was exposed. Isabella found out her family’s ruin was plotted by her stepmother. Adrian discovered Bella was his long-lost lover and Leo’s mother. The villains were punished. Isabella regained her fortune and lived happily with Adrian and Leo.

Title: The Duke's Masked Wife
Synopsis: A scarred noblewoman sold by her own father enters a contract marriage with a cold, dangerous duke to escape a brutal fate — but when their bargain turns into love, they must survive family betrayal, murder accusations, and a vengeful brother determined to destroy them both.

Title: The Eagle Soars and Reigns
Synopsis: While many reporters were waiting at the press conference hosted by the Lloyd Group, which owned assets in the billions, Frank Lloyd declared domineeringly that he had found his long-lost son, Aidan. And this also set Aidan, who was about to propose, on a different path in life...

Title: The Elven Princess's Revenge
Tags: Revenge; Hidden Identity; Enemies to Lovers
Synopsis: Five years ago, because of a prophecy, the elves were brutally besieged and slaughtered by humans. Princess Gloria of the elves witnessed with her own eyes her parents being killed by Rose, the wife of a human duke. Bent on revenge, she renounced her identity as an elven princess and disguised herself as the ugliest maid in Grey Manor. Step by step, she schemed, deftly wielding her charms and playing the part of the weak, and eventually won the undivided favor of Duke Kevin. Yet even she could not help falling for him. But it was only after she had successfully taken her revenge on Rose, leaving her with nothing, that she discovered the truth: the one who had truly orchestrated her parents' death was not Rose, but Kevin…

Title: The Ember of Mars
Synopsis: In the medieval Roman Empire, Lucius Naevius, a descendant of Mars, the God of War, and commander of the imperial legions, has long defended the empire against monstrous beasts from Roman mythology—such as Cerberus and Hydra—ensuring its safety.  Just as Lucius prepares to propose to Aurelia, daughter of the noble Cornelius family, the Chimera invades the empire. Ordered to lead an army into battle, Lucius departs without knowing that Aurelia is already pregnant.  During the war, Lucius is gravely wounded by the Chimera and falls into a coma, remaining unconscious for eight years. When he awakens, he immediately returns to Rome—the Eternal City—to find Aurelia.  During those eight years, Aurelia has given birth to their son, Marcus, alone. Refusing a politically arranged marriage orchestrated by her family and the Senate, she has suffered abuse at their hands.  Upon returning to the Eternal City, Lucius rescues his son Marcus from thugs, reunites with his former subordinate Decimus Lew

Title: The Endless day
Synopsis: Sean Cohen found himself trapped in a time loop on August 8th for a thousand years, where every day at midnight, his life would reset to the same day. But this day, he unexpectedly broke free from the time loop...

Title: The Eternal Love
Synopsis: Qu Tan’er, a modern-day history intern, accidentally transmigrates into the body of a concubine-born daughter from the Minister’s household who attempted to take her own life by jumping into a river. She is soon forced to marry the cold and ruthless Eighth Prince, Mo Liancheng. Determined to return to the modern world, Qu Tan’er repeatedly tests an ancient jade bed believed to possess the power to transport her through time, leading to one hilarious mishap after another. As they spend more time together, Qu Tan’er and Mo Liancheng gradually fall in love. Side by side, they thwart the schemes of the Crown Prince, her elder legitimate sister, and their other enemies. In the end, Qu Tan’er chooses to remain in the past and spends the rest of her life with Mo Liancheng after he ascends the throne.

Title: The Fallen Dragon's Rise
Synopsis: Su Han, sovereign of a sacred realm, perished and woke up in a crippled body. Stripped of his dragon veins, he rebuilt his cultivation from nothing, founded the "Slayer of Gods" sect, and ascended to cosmic supremacy.

Title: The Fallen Princess Blood and Fire Over the Capital
Synopsis: "When she was young, Ella rescued an injured black dragon, forging a fateful bond of kindness. Years later, her stepmother colludes with the prime minister to poison the king and frames Ella for conspiring with the dragon to murder her father. Ella is thrown into a death cell, yet her loyal former followers risk their lives to break her out. She flees back to the Misty Forest, resolved to ally with the great dragon to gather evidence, expose the villains’ conspiracy, and uphold justice to clear both her name and the late king’s through the law."

Title: The Fool Who Became a Legend
Synopsis: Five years ago, a car accident leaves genius Fynn Snow mentally impaired. When his seven brothers and three uncles all die in battle, his fiancee dumps him at the funeral. His brother’s late fiancee steps up and says, \"If you won't marry him, I will.\" At that, Fynn panics.

Title: The Fourth Prince's Secret Lover
Synopsis: Time-travel tragedy: Ye Zao, a novice, trapped as Fourth Prince's concubine. No status, no skills.  But with prince's risky affection and her ambition for a better life, she aims to defy odds, rise from the ashes.

Title: The Glory: Returning of The Queen
Tags: Empress; Strong FL; Rebirth; Revenge; Second Chance
Synopsis: Liz Swift, once betrayed and falsely accused by her step-sister Ann and insulted by Ryan Piers, finds herself reborn before her engagement. Seizing this second chance, she marries Ollie Piers, Ryan's elder brother, to exact revenge on those who wronged her!

Title: The Healer: Who Plays by His Own Rules
Synopsis: City life is a whole new world for Marc. Between navigating dangerous rivals and unexpected romances, he uses his unmatched medical skills and strength to survive and seek vengeance. But his journey is far from over. What dangers and desires await the healer next?

Title: The hivemind is conquering for me?
Synopsis: So, reincarnation huh? "A lot of good... A lot of bad... Balanced karma." "Good news, you get one boon to bring with you to the next life. Unfortunately for you though, you don't get to choose. Totally random. Ready?" Join Apollo in his new life where through sheer luck (Good or bad?) Is raised by an all hungry, all dominant and all loving hivemind who will burn the galaxy just to see him smile.

Title: The Hunter’s Vampire Husband
Synopsis: "Elena, a monster hunter, and Julian, a pure-blood vampire, fall in love and build a life together. They conceal their true identities to enjoy peaceful, warm days side by side. When rebel factions stir up chaos, their secrets are accidentally revealed, leaving them hunted by countless forces. Through countless perils and life-or-death trials, they hold unwavering trust in each other and stand by one another faithfully. In the end, they walk away from all conflicts, retreat into the quiet mountains, and live a peaceful, unrestrained life hand in hand."

Title: The Idle Prince and His Doctor Wife
Synopsis: A forensic pathologist is brought back in time and becomes a cowardly wife of a prince? No problem, her prince is also an idle one. What a perfect match! Unexpectedly, one day, he points at the country: “I will be the emperor of this country.” Well, you are now being so ambitious. Go play the game yourself. I, Tang Shijiu, am quitting.

Title: The Jersey Chaser's Endgame
Synopsis: For five years, I was NFL superstar Gordon Ryder’s secret wife. Then he went public with his new romance on Instagram. TMZ painted me as a psycho. A "jersey chaser." His fans crucified me all over the internet. My cheating husband played the lovesick hero, while I was the villain.

Title: The Last Anniversary
Synopsis: "On the night of their fifth wedding anniversary, their neighbor Lily deliberately sabotages the water pipes as a ploy to seduce Mark, the husband. Serena catches them in the act, yet Mark shows no remorse whatsoever. Instead, he shifts all blame onto her and drives her out of their home. Serena returns to her wealthy family’s estate, determined to exact revenge. Using her access privileges, she locks and wipes all core data of Mark’s company and takes away the backup hard drives, pushing his business to the verge of bankruptcy. Later, she summons Mark to the Ward Manor, her family’s property, for negotiations. It is only then that Mark realizes his wife’s background is far more formidable than he imagined, and a full-scale counterattack is set in motion."

Title: The Last Dragon Caller
Tags: Revenge; Reverse Harem; Weak to Strong; Hidden Identity
Synopsis: Leona, last of the Dragon-Callers, escapes her clan's massacre. Thirteen years later, she infiltrates tyrant Magnus's camp as a laundry slave, reunites with fallen tribesmen Rand and Aidan, and forms a fragile alliance. She awakens a new dragon, wields its flame to destroy the tyrant, and follows her heart in choosing her protector.

Title: The Lord's Comeback
Synopsis: Valiant above all, crowned by conquered lands, yet betrayed and trapped in the mortal realm, awakening amidst the dust, his fury shakes the heavens!

Title: The Love Doctor His Submissive
Synopsis: The sex doctor Marcus comes to Ann's home. Ann initially speaks rudely to him, which worries her best friend Silver. Silver persuades Ann to cooperate with the treatment for her own good, then apologizes to Marcus and asks him to help cure Ann. After a brief farewell between the two friends, Ann takes her luggage, gets into Marcus's luxury car, and they drive away together.

Title: The Lunar Curse: A Second Chance With Alpha Draven
Tags: Werewolf; Weak to Strong; Hidden Identity; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Cursed by the Moon Goddess and stripped of her wolf form, Meredith is publicly rejected by her fated mate Marc at the full moon banquet. Her rival tears away her veil and exposes her scar, leaving her to endure scorn and humiliation from all sides. At her lowest moment, Alpha Draven arrives, claims her as his own, and takes her to his pack. Facing betrayal, abuse, and war between their peoples,  Meredith discovers she is the long-lost princess of the vampire royal bloodline. Standing beside Draven, she faces the united wrath of the wolf packs. When her seal shatters and the Blood Moon Queen awakens, Meredith unleashes unprecedented power—ending the war, being crowned queen, forging lasting peace between both races, and rising from outcast to sovereign.

Title: THE LYCAN KING’S MATE
Synopsis: Dive into The Lycan King’s Mate, where love is a battlefield, and secrets are deadlier than claws.

Synopsis: Alina,unexpectedly becomes their marked mate and must fight to survive against palace scheming, a jealous Luna candidate, and a mysterious rogue wolf that claims her as its own.

Title: The Mafia Don's Unruly sister
Synopsis: "Thinking she had finally broken free from her family’s violence, Ariana had no choice but to attend the party her father would throw to celebrate the man she had always hated. The ruthless mafia lord Matteo Donatelli, whom her family had taken under their wing when she was a teenager."

Title: The Mafia Lord's Secret Lover
Tags: Strong FL; Baby; Revenge; One Night Stand; Family; Mafia; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Reckless night with her father's enemy ruined heiress Evelyn Walters. Pregnant and cast out, she fled. He wants her and his son—can she trust her child's father, her guardian's enemy?

Title: The Mafias Dirty Little Slut
Synopsis: When innocent Isabella is forced into a brutal contract with the ruthless Domenico mafia brothers, she is drawn into a dark world of violence, possession, and forbidden lust that blurs the line between submission and survival.

Title: The Magnificent Bodyguard
Synopsis: Caspian is the world's deadliest special forces soldier, haunted by his parents' mysterious fate. To find answers, he accepts one mission: protect Chloe Brooks, the genius CEO behind DIVINIA — the cure for cancer. Hunted by ruthless men who want her miracle drug, Chloe will do anything to save it and her sister Iris. Caspian saves her again and again. But who IS he? Why does he fight like a legend? And can Chloe trust him — when their first meeting was a scorching one-night stand?

Title: The Making of a Lioness
Synopsis: Claire Stone was once a gentle young lady. But she was murdered by her own father and sister. After she is reborn, she faces the world with boldness. She uncovers the conspiracy, preventing the tragedy of her previous life. Ultimately, Claire successfully inherits the fortune and finds true love.

Title: The Marked Mate of the Lycan King
Synopsis: OMFG! A rejected Omega who survived four years in a kennel is the fated Silver-Eyed Rogue heir?! Esmeralda, with mysterious silver scars on her forearms, just wanted to hide and survive—until ruthless Lycan King Demetrius abducts her, craving the secret path through the Shadow Canyons only she knows.

Title: The Marvelous Doctor
Synopsis: Cillian Scott discovered his fiancée held the key to his cultivation breakthrough. By saving lives and battling evil in the city, he showcased his value. Through perseverance, he ultimately achieved his goal, weaving a tale of determination, love, and triumph over adversity.

Title: The Masked Queen：Path to Reclaim the Throne
Synopsis: Aria, princess of the Silverfang Tribe, is betrayed by her lover Julian and her best friend Serena. They rip out and shatter her wolf core before abandoning her in a mass grave. On the brink of death, Kael, a supreme Alpha demon, saves her and binds her with a soul contract. He awakens her ancient Darkgold Primordial Bloodline, and she takes on the new identity Aurora. Two years later, she attends Julian and Serena’s wedding masked as a senior executive of the Bloodmoon Conglomerate, having acquired half of the tribe’s outstanding debts. At the reception, she thwarts Serena’s successive underhanded schemes. With the overwhelming power of her primordial bloodline, she forces Serena to her knees. She then devises a clever ploy that compels Julian to hand over the necklace left by her late mother to settle his debts.

Title: The Masked Wolf Heir's Redemption
Synopsis: Thorne, the young leader of the Black Wolf clan, concealed his true identity as a pampered youth and transformed into the enigmatic powerhouse known as the "Wolf God," investigating his mother's death. During the Beast Trial, he defeated formidable enemies from the northern territories, exposed the conspiracy between his stepmother and Gurtan, ultimately avenged his wrongful accusations, married the royal princess, and became the heir apparent of the Beast Clan.

Title: The Master Who Becomes Invincible
Synopsis: Bai Yu transmigrates into a xuanhuan world, becoming the sect master of the White Jade Sect, a ninth-rate sect. The moment he wakes up, he learns his sect is on the brink of being absorbed by the Heavenly One Cult. Just then, Bai Yu successfully claims his newbie reward: binding the Disciple-Taking Ten-Thousandfold Return System, which multiplies and returns any item he gifts to his disciples. From then on, Bai Yu leads the White Jade Sect and his increasingly "gifted" disciples on a path of rise, rise, rise, rise! "Ding! You gifted your disciple a plain steamed bun, triggering a ten-thousandfold return. Congratulations, you've obtained ten thousand plain steamed buns!" "Ding! You gifted your disciple Li Xiu the bottom-tier technique 'Eighth Set of Radio Calisthenics,' triggering a ten-thousandfold return. Congratulations, you've obtained the divine-tier technique 'Supreme Xuan Body Technique'!" Years later: "Emperor Bai Yu is already overwhelmingly strong on his own, but why are his d

Title: The Master's Urban Odyssey
Synopsis: Ian Schwartz went down to city with a mission of looking for his fiancée. Seeing that his beautiful fiancée was in a wheel chair and bullied by a bunch of mean girls, he just could not take it. "It's not cool when someone tries to bully me. And it gets worse when my girl is bullied!" he yelled in fury.

Title: The Missing Rock God
Synopsis: A year after the legendary “Rock God” disappears, he resurfaces working quietly at a venue famous for launching musical legends. But when his forbidden crush, the owner, begs for help in stopping her scheming uncle from destroying them with his ruthless take over, the Rock God is forced into the spotlight once again. Every performance threatens to expose him, while every moment with her threatens his resolve to stay hidden.

Title: The Mommy Contract
Synopsis: When Lily Arnold is at her wit's end, young Leo Stewart suddenly appears and boldly claims he wants to rent her as his mommy. Having never even had a boyfriend, Lily has no idea that the kid right in front of her is actually her biological son!

Title: The Monster Bride：Bound to the Black Dragon Billionaire
Synopsis: In a world where monsters rule, human Eleanor—abused by her family and sister Cecilia, who is engaged to werewolf Simon—is beaten and abandoned. Near death, dragonman Aldric claims her as his fated bride to save his dying race. He protects her from Simon's wrath, shocking all: why does a legendary dragonman guard Eleanor?

Title: The Monster's 18th Bride
Synopsis: Young Elara is chosen as a sacrifice to the Abyssal Lord who has ruled the depths for five hundred years. Certain that death awaits her, she instead encounters an immortal king—devastatingly handsome, fiercely temperamental, and utterly indifferent to the world.  At first, he orders her to leave, wanting nothing to do with her. Yet when the curse of the full moon drives him into a violent frenzy, she alone remains by his side, offering unwavering loyalty and gentle comfort when no one else dares approach.  The world believes Elara perished long ago. But everything changes when the Abyssal Castle descends upon the royal capital. Before the eyes of a stunned kingdom, the feared Dark Lord kneels on one knee and pledges himself with absolute devotion—not to a queen or a goddess, but to his mortal bride.

Title: The Mysterious Ray
Synopsis: Ray Scott had his soul trapped in God Realm while he suffered dementia for five years and was taken in by Celia Reid. When he regained his soul and power, he completed Jonsy Group’s top ten missions and found that the girl he had been looking for was Celia.

Title: The Night Keeper
Tags: SuperHuman; Adventure; Weak to Strong; Counterattack; Superpowers; Global Awakening; Horror
Synopsis: A broke mechanic accidentally becomes the night watchman of an anomaly containment station. He discovers that the "monsters" are actually traumatized spirits trapped in historical objects—and uses his unique dullness, repair skills, and empathy to soothe them. But he soon realizes: Station 7 itself might be the biggest containment object of all.

Title: The Night We Shouldn't
Tags: Mafia; Second Chance; Age Gap; R18
Synopsis: "Anne’s college life collapses amid a meticulously orchestrated betrayal. Her boyfriend Jimmy wagers and wins her virginity in a bet, while her best friend Amy leaks her private videos to the public. As she collapses on the floor, engulfed by camera flashes, the ballroom doors swing open. Adrian, Jimmy’s father and a mafia don, takes a bullet meant for her, shielding her from an assassin.  From that moment on, Anne is dragged into an even more dangerous world. Adrian teaches her how to hold a gun, ushers her into the inner circle of power, and marks his absolute possession of her with belts and love bites. He is her ex-boyfriend’s father, the ruler of the city’s underworld — the man who demands she call him “Daddy.”"

Title: The Oracle's Curse
Tags: Hidden Feelings; Strong FL; Baby; Love Triangle; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Healer Penelope, forced to feign betrayal, raises her son alone for six years to protect her lover Odysseus from a fabricated curse. Returning as a war hero, Odysseus obsessively pursues the truth, discovering the child shares his traits. Despite Daphne’s relentless schemes to tear them apart, Odysseus finds the scroll of the false oracle. The truth shatters six years of painful lies, and Penelope’s sacrifices are finally revealed. Reconciled, they embrace a new beginning, their family united at last, proving love’s strength over destiny’s cruel deception.

Title: The Outcast Princess Is A War God
Synopsis: Framed by her stepmother at six, Eleanor was banished to the North on the pretext of being frail. Fifteen years later, she has risen to become Ardenville’s First Knight. To help her long-abused elder sister, Serena, claim the throne, Eleanor returns to the royal court as chief judge of the succession trial. The once-banished “worthless girl” is back—determined to rewrite her fate and make her enemies pay.

Title: The Permanence
Synopsis: Isabella, a lonely and rebellious student trapped in a cold elite school and a suffocating family, is irresistibly drawn to Alejandro, a powerful, brooding millionaire who becomes both her dangerous obsession and her only escape—igniting a forbidden, passionate romance that blurs the line between control and love.

Title: The President's  Runaway Wife
Synopsis: Nancy owed loan sharks, so she turned to Jimi, who slept with her under drugs. Nancy ended up pregnant, held captive by Jimi, then tossed into a river by his jealous fiancée, Yura. Jimi later found Nancy and their child. Despite struggles, they eventually found happiness together.

Title: The Promised Princess
Synopsis: The man who was supposed to be there was determined to try his luck once more. He had no intention of giving up, and his bright, intelligent eyes, which didn't reflect the painful events of the years, showed his stubbornness. The burden on his broad shoulders was very heavy; sometimes he didn't feel well enough to carry it, but he had been responsible once and was quite pleased with it. He would find her, even at the cost of his life. He entered the first school in his new country, and as always, all eyes turned to him; the attention given to a foreigner was deserved—he carried all the perfection of his race.

Title: The Quarterback Howls at Night
Synopsis: "Noah Rivers was never meant to lead. Not again. Not after what happened ten years ago. But when the true Alpha of the Blood Moon Pack is forced to hide among humans, football becomes his only escape and he becomes the school’s star quarterback with the weight of the team on his shoulders. As scouts circle and his shot at the NFL grows real, there is just one problem: his grades are tanking, and if he fails, everything’s over. Enter Riley Prescott—flawless cheer captain, top of the class, this year’s prom queen in waiting, and the girl he can’t stand. As head cheerleader and student council president, she is used to fixing messes, not babysitting the football team’s academic disaster. So, when she’s forced to tutor him, she plans to make his life hell.

Title: The queen who raised her enemy's son
Synopsis: "Frigga, Queen of Asgard, discovers her husband Loki and trusted sorceress Gullveig swapped her newborn daughter with their own son. Rather than confronting them, Frigga secretly recovers her daughter Nicole, raising her in the Norn Temple while pretending to nurture the impostor Bryan as heir.  Decades later, when Loki's family publicly betrays Frigga and seizes power, Nicole reveals herself at her own wedding to Bryan — not as his bride, but as Frigga's true daughter and the Nine Realms' most powerful queen. Their empire collapses overnight. Frigga reclaims everything, then passes her legacy to Nicole, finally embracing freedom."

Title: The Real Beginning at Forty-Eight
Synopsis: After 30 years together, Carol Adams discovers on her 48th birthday that her husband Greg Adams secretly married his first love 29 years ago, and even their children knew. When he repeatedly chooses his legal wife, Carol exposes the truth at her birthday banquet and walks away to start anew.

Title: The Reclaimed Heir
Synopsis: Tania Jones’s unexpected pregnancy with Mason Brooks saved her from an arranged marriage, but she was forced to leave home. Five years later, he finds their son and starts pursuing her. Zoey York schemes against her, but a moment of crisis reveals Tania was switched at birth with Zoey.

Title: The Rejected Ex-mate secret Identity
Synopsis: To Alpha Paris, Ember MacGregor was nothing but a powerless, barren Omega—one he subjected to endless humiliation. He cheated on her, marked his fated mate Kate, and forced Ember to donate a kidney to atone for Kate’s lies. Finally, fed up, she publicly rejects him. After losing her, Paris begs for her return, but Ember has reclaimed her strength—and the hidden identity she once lost!

Title: The Rejected luna, the Hidden Heiress
Tags: Werewolf; Strong FL; Hidden Identity; Love Triangle; Face-slapping
Synopsis: Abandoning all her royal honors, Princess Selene concealed her lineage as a common Omega and wedded Victor, the Alpha of her clan. Three years of love ended in betrayal. A terrible accident gave rise to false accusations, and he attempted to bribe her into taking the fall for his fated mate, Camella. After fleeing back to the royal palace, Selene was still plagued by endless malicious rumors and repeated framing from the outside world. Yet blinded by lies time and again, Victor kept hurting her over and over again. Camella’s fake pregnancy was revealed at last. Victor defended Selene with his life and uncovered every secret. When he realized she was the kingdom’s princess, it was already too late to salvage their romance. Now she is the future ruler, and he is her loyal subordinate. Their love is gone, but he vows to serve her and the kingdom with all his life.

Title: The Richest Man in the World After Devaluation
Synopsis: Confronted with the tragic events of his mother's death and his fiancée's betrayal, Herbert reaches the depths of despair. But at his darkest moment, everything in the world except his fortune has depreciated a million times, making him the richest man in the world. Just witness Herbert's journey as he outmaneuvers the wealthy elite, captures the admiration of beautiful women, and ascends to the peak of his life.

Title: The Scorned Princess Is a Goddess
Tags: Empress; Strong FL; Reverse Harem; Face-slapping
Synopsis: Princess Freya, the elf, was abandoned as a child and grew up in the thorn forest. Years later, she unexpectedly returned to the elf kingdom and awakened the power of the sacred tree, but her father denied her and the other elves doubted her. When a goblin army invaded and the elf clan faced a crisis, Freya chose to protect her family and people, using the power of the gods to drive back the dark forces and uncover the secrets of her identity.

Title: The Secret Game with My Best Friend’s Father
Tags: Forbidden Love; Age Gap; Second Chance
Synopsis: Chloe returns home from a business trip only to catch her boyfriend Liam cheating on her with her best friend Serena. Heartbroken, she meets the sophisticated Arthur at a bar and spends an intimate night with him. The next day, she puts on a calm facade and attends a dinner party at Serena’s house, where she is shocked to discover that Arthur is Serena’s father. After witnessing the two traitors’ illicit affair once more, Arthur proposes a revenge alliance: he will help Chloe punish the unfaithful pair in exchange for equal compensation. Driven by her desire for vengeance, Chloe agrees to submit to his terms, and the two form a secret pact. They launch their counterattack right under the betrayers’ noses, plotting methodically to make the unfaithful couple pay for their wrongdoing.

Title: THE Seventh Element
Synopsis: "Alex, an ordinary office worker, dies from overwork. He transmigrates to Diamont, a world of swords and magic, only to inhabit the body of a worthless outcast — a dragon‑feeding orphan with zero magical talent. Bullied relentlessly at the magic academy, he accidentally awakens an ancient crystal, becoming the world’s first‑ever all‑element mage who wields fire, water, wind, earth, light and darkness all at once. Starting by shattering a magic stele with one strike, he tames an ancient dragon sealed for a thousand years, claims the legendary Staff of Annihilation, and slays the demon vanguard. Step by step, he rises from a worthless nobody to the supreme commander of the allied forces across six kingdoms."

Title: The Sixth Prince Strikes Back
Synopsis: Armed with memories of the future, Sixth Prince Zhao Yi steals the hero’s fate, opportunities, and women one by one. Once a pathetic simp, he now crushes enemies with ruthless schemes, royal power, and absolute confidence.

Title: The Snowmoon Healer
Synopsis: Although Adellee is the daughter of Snowmmoon Pack Alpha,a healer and warrior, she has never been able to shift. In order to fulfill the ancestral covenant, she was forced to marry the notorious Silver Moon Pack Alpha Kayden. At the beginning of the Silver Moon, Adellee encountered a series of framing by Kayden's ex girlfriend Louisa and public provocation by warrior Lexas, but she defeated her opponent and stunned the Silver Moon Pack Members. Kayden's wolf was attracted to Adellee and forcibly kept her by his side to sleep with him. The chemistry between them appeared with the help of their mate bond. However, at the same time, a pair of blood red eyes were watching Adellee in the dark, and a mysterious moon goddess prophet told Kayden that Adellee had been bound to darkness.

Title: The Starlight Seamstress
Synopsis: In the magical city of Glowhaven, emotions are the source of all energy. Joy, anger, sorrow, and love can be collected, refined, and transformed by Emotion Tailors—the only people capable of weaving, storing, and shaping emotions into tangible forms.  A century ago, a terrifying entity known as the Void Shadow emerged. Born from humanity’s collective negative emotions, it fed on hope and happiness, pushing the city to the brink of despair. To stop it, Stella’s great-grandmother—the first legendary Emotion Tailor—poured all her love into creating a guardian named Lorian. At the cost of her own life, she sealed both Lorian and the Void Shadow inside a mystical Emotion Fabric.  Now, only someone who carries her bloodline can awaken Lorian through pure love. But the one who awakens him will also become the Void Shadow’s next target.

Title: The stolen heir
Tags: Baby; Strong FL; One Night Stand
Synopsis: Five years ago, Duke Reinhardt Augustus spent a night with half-elf Sylvia by a moonlit lake, and she later bore a daughter, Liana. Sylvia's half-sister Veronica used her lost necklace to impersonate her and passed off her own son as the Duke's heir. Five years later, Sylvia brings Liana to the capital for better magical education. Reinhardt, suspicious of his false heir, hires Sylvia as an apothecary. Sylvia's gentleness and Liana's dual magic awaken Reinhardt's dormant feelings. Veronica's schemes and lies are ultimately exposed. Reinhardt, Sylvia, and Liana are united as their true family.

Title: The Strongest War God
Tags: War God; Family; Romance; Revenge; War
Synopsis: Originally a commoner, at eighteen, he ruled the world. He is Braydon Neal! For a decade, he fought to protect his homeland in the north. Upon his triumphant return, with sword in hand, he vowed to avenge his parents' unforgivable grievances.

Title: The Substitute Bride Is No Fool
Tags: Strong FL; Face-slapping; Rebirth; Hidden Identity
Synopsis: The legendary Harper Young is reborn as Harper Miller, a supposedly dim-witted fake heiress. Scorned by her adoptive parents and targeted by the real heiress, she reclaims her true name, Harper Young, cuts ties with the Millers, and strikes back at everyone who humiliated her. Silas Caldwell—the mysterious Mr. World—had formed a profound bond with Harper in her previous life. Believing her dead, he conceals his identity and sets out to break off his engagement to the fake heiress, only to discover that she is far from the fool everyone believes her to be. One by one, Harper’s astonishing identities are revealed: the Peerless Healer, the Sovereign Gambler, the God of Hackers, and the AI Architect. Each revelation leaves the Millers more humiliated than the last. Overcome with emotion, Silas pulls Harper into his arms. “I’ve finally found you. Does the wager from our previous life still stand? This time, I won’t let you leave me again.”

Title: The Ten -Day Oath
Synopsis: Betrayed by her husband Ares, mortal Cassandra initiates a magical divorce through the Mirror of Destiny. Abducted and nearly killed by his mistress Helen, she is saved by Triton, the Sea God's son. Cassandra joins the Sea Temple, masters her prophecy, and discovers she is the lost daughter of the Goddess of Fate. As her old life crumbles, she finds true love and power, leaving Ares to face his ruin.

Title: The Third Time I Died For You
Synopsis: The first time, I stood on the balcony of our unfinished penthouse apartment, ready to leap. Jasper saved me, only to accuse me of doing it all for attention. The second time, I washed down half a bottle of antidepressants with the whiskey he’d bought me. He’d burst in at the last second, clutching me and sobbing that he knew he’d been wrong. There’s always a third time, a fourth, and a fifth, isn’t there?

Title: The Three Lords Crave Her Breast Milk
Tags: Beloved by All; Forbidden Love; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Hired as a wet nurse at Silvermoon Manor, Alice captivates the three brothers: Edward depends on her, Lucas proposes passionately inside a nursery wardrobe, and the manic eldest, Leo, is drawn to her scent. As passion peaks inside the closet, Leo arrives outside. Peeking through the crack, Alice realizes in terror that Leo is the "madman" who once assaulted her in the woods—just as his hand pulls the handle open.

Title: The Transformed Princess: Bearing the Duke’s Heir for Revenge
Synopsis: Amid the war between the Kingdom of Aura and the dragon realm of Draka, Lily unexpectedly saves the life of the gravely wounded Dragon Prince, Silver. Silver believes she is his destined love and vows to belong only to her. For Lily, he becomes the only light in her dark life. But after her eighteenth birthday, a devastating truth shatters everything—Camila is the true princess of Aura. Lily is accused of stealing Camila’s identity for eighteen years and falls from grace, subjected to rejection and humiliation. To end the war between the two kingdoms, Draka proposes a royal marriage alliance with Aura. Torn between power and duty, Silver can only deceive Lily for the time being. Then Lily discovers that she is carrying his child. The Aura royal family will never allow an “impostor princess” to keep the Dragon Prince’s heir.

Title: The Twisted Wedding Night
Synopsis: Betrayed by her husband and cousin, homeless Lily is rescued by Emma, discovers she’s pregnant from a night with a mysterious savior, gives birth alone, then takes a live-in nanny job in New York—unaware the powerful father of her child has been hunting her for years.

Title: The Tycoon's Rejection
Synopsis: While Miss Sanders navigates the challenges of her daily routine—eating, sleeping, and teaching a lesson to those who have tormented her—Mr. Ballot finds himself consumed by a singular mission: capturing the heart of Miss Sanders.

Title: THE UNREACHABLE HEART
Synopsis: A sharp, sincere new analyst captures the heart of a cold, work-obsessed tech CEO; after a cruel betrayal frames her, he learns to let go of pride, fights for her, and builds a love-fueled tech empire with her.

Title: The Vampire & Her Witch
Tags: Power Couple; Vampire; Strong FL; Hidden Feelings; Suspense; Forbidden Love; Revenge; Second Chance; Weak to Strong; Face-slapping
Synopsis: On her wedding night, Ashlyn's new husband Owen brutally tortured and murdered her before burying her alive in a bid to seize complete control over the iron mining industry passed through generations of the Lothian family. What she did not know yet was that the other mastermind behind this fatal conspiracy was none other than Jocelyn, her own younger sister! Having narrowly escaped death, Ashlyn fled barefoot across the wilderness as the heavy rain abated, wrapped only in bloodstained rags. She encountered the Lady of the Abyss, Lady Nyriel, who offered a helping hand with secrets of her own.

Title: The Varkas Brothers: And Their Princess
Synopsis: "I can feel it in the way their eyes flash when they’re angry. In the way their bodies burn hotter than they should. In the way they move, like predators in the dark. I don’t know what they are."
