At the brink of death, he awakens the **Urban King of Hell System**, gaining the ability to see through the lies of the powerful—their hidden weaknesses, offshore fortunes, and darkest secrets exposed as data before his eyes.  But taking down the vast web of corruption requires allies. Jake recruits a team of brilliant outcasts: a genius psychologist, a world-class hacker, a battle-hardened veteran, and a ruthless Wall Street strategist.  Together, they wage war against the elites who control the city from the shadows. As conspiracies deepen, Jake realizes he is fighting not just for revenge, but for justice in a world where the system itself has been corrupted.

Title: The Villain's Little Cat
Tags: Forbidden Love; Apocalypse; Comedy; Sweet Love; Doomsday
Synopsis: Hi, I'm Kate — a soon-to-graduate college girl whose life is basically: class, papers, food, sleep, repeat. Oh, and secretly crushing on my professor, Kyle. Riiiveting, I know. Then one day, a mysterious red rain changed EVERYTHING. And I... turned into a cat?! And Professor Kyle just casually brought me home?! Oh my god, how is this my life right now! But okay, being a cat isn't so bad — turns out cats can get away with literally anything. PS: Professor Kyle's abs? Absolutely purr-worthy.  But wait — I'm not exactly a normal cat.And my "superpowers" are about to land me in some seriously big trouble...

Title: The Villainous Female Drops the Act: Five Beast Husbands from the Start
Tags: Transmigration; Beloved by All; Weak to Strong; System
Synopsis: When Shen Tang wakes up, her entire world collapses. She has been transported to a post-apocalyptic beast world and become an ugly, lazy, 330-pound villainess hated to the bone by her five S-rank Beast husbands. A seductive red fox, a domineering black panther, a brooding white snake, a tyrannical merman, and a tough golden-eagle general—all five avoid her like the plague. Fortunately, Shen Tang becomes bound to a Handsome Men Conquest System. As long as she raises the five Beast husbands’ favor scores, the system will gradually transform her into a beauty. Starting at a favor score of –99, Shen Tang slowly wins them all over. Before long, the five Beast husbands are fighting over who gets to cuddle with her. How did the female everyone despised become the one everyone adores?

Title: The Wallflower and the Alphas
Synopsis: This is a reverse harem story about a bullied teenage girl who discovers she is bonded to four popular boys, navigating love, revenge, and supernatural secrets in a dangerous high school world.

Title: The War Ring
Synopsis: Jack, an ordinary college student, endures long‑term bullying on campus. After being cornered and beaten one day, he stumbles upon a mysterious alien ring. Overnight, he awakens superpowers — yet this drags him into an irreversible fate. Bruce, the captain of a secret agency named S.H.I.E.L.D. (Star‑Shield Bureau), tracks him down. He reveals the ring is an extraterrestrial artifact with an irreversible bond to its bearer. On the condition that Jack keeps his student status, the boy is forced to join the organisation. From then on, he leads a double life, torn between campus life and the battlefield.

Title: The Wife's Revenge: Marrying the Blind Billionaire
Synopsis: "After losing everyone she’s ever loved, Adeline has learned that survival sometimes means swallowing pain in silence. Orphaned young and raised by her grandmother, Adeline’s life has been nothing but a string of heartbreaks. When she thought she finally found love in Alistair, he turned out to be the man who would shatter her completely, cheating on her, marrying another woman, and leaving her to endure the cruel abuse of his family. Pregnant, betrayed, and broken, Adeline runs away with nothing but a faint hope that somewhere, somehow, she can start anew. A bus ride to nowhere leads her to an unexpected place and to Gideon Lancaster, a reclusive billionaire blinded by a tragic accident. Known for his sharp tongue and ruthless temper, Gideon drives away anyone who dares to get close. But Adeline isn’t easily broken anymore. Beneath her quiet endurance lies a strength forged in pain, and Gideon, angry, lonely, and haunted by his own past, can’t help but be drawn to the woman who refuse

Synopsis: After being struck by a truck like most protagonists, Vaan found himself transmigrated into a world dominated by the witches. Every man must learn how to service the witches to survive.    As a prodigy in the art of pleasing women, Vaan lived a smooth two years since his transmigration.     However, everything came crashing down in a heartbeat one day when his life was nearly taken, and Lady Eniwse, whom he served, went berserk.

Title: Three Wives, One Destiny
Synopsis: Yosef Lambert unexpectedly crosses over to Drakonwyn Empire, finding himself as a down-and-out scholar who awakens an affinity system. In the midst of turmoil, he teams up with his three wives to build a fortune, ultimately becoming a formidable hero of his time.

Title: Three Years After Her Fake Death, the Tyrant Turned Ruthless
Synopsis: Song Yi is accidentally transported into a novel, where she becomes the only woman by the side of a tyrannical emperor. The System gives her one mission: to win the tyrant’s heart and become the one unforgettable love he can never let go of. Song Yi teaches him joy and sorrow, love and hatred, longing and loss—showing him what it truly means to love someone. But the moment her mission is complete, she returns to the modern world without looking back. For the next three years, Song Yi builds a successful new life. Then one morning, the world before her begins to warp, and she is suddenly pulled back into the novel. The tyrant has spent all three years searching for her. Countless substitutes have appeared at his side, each resembling Song Yi in looks or temperament, yet none can ever take her place in his heart. He loves her, but he also hates her for disappearing without a word. Refusing to believe that she is dead, he has never stopped searching. Back in the palace, Song Yi dares not

Title: Three Years With My Billionaire Husband
Synopsis: Amara, whose life collapses after betrayal, job loss, and her mother’s death, is horrified to learn she’s pregnant—and targeted by a dangerous, long-hidden biological father who will hunt her, kidnap her, and claim her unborn child as his bloodline, forcing her to fight for survival with the help of a mysterious man who shares her forgotten past.

Title: Tide of Forbidden Touch
Tags: Reverse Harem; Forbidden Love; Age Gap; R18
Synopsis: Newlywed wife Emma was on her honeymoon in Hawaii when her husband Jack arranged for her father-in-law Victor to teach her how to surf. The husband was piloting a motorboat ahead, sharing a surfboard with Emma. Victor tightly hugged Emma from behind, experiencing a sustained and secretive desire that gradually spiraled out of control amidst the intense waves. Emma and Victor engaged in a forbidden love affair.

Title: TIME WARNING
Synopsis: Before the apocalyptic heatwave strikes, Sophia, a woman living alone, sees a video of her future self before opening the door to her boyfriend James, who comes asking for supplies. She discovers her terrifying fate and realizes something is wrong. Outside, James and his accomplices try to trick and force their way in. Trapped behind a single door, Sophia fights back with courage and wit, turning the tables on them.

Title: To Bleed a Fated Bond
Tags: Werewolf; Baby; Tragedy; Abusive Love; Love Triangle; Rebirth
Synopsis: On the day my twin pups were due, I forced myself to delay labor. I held on until the next day to watch my mate, Damien, announce that Selena had been the first to bear him an Alpha heir. In my last life, I thought giving him the firstborn would make him mine.  Selena and her pup died in childbirth. Damien murdered our pups inside my womb and killed me with his own hands in front of Selena's grave. When I opened my eyes again, I had returned to that day. This time, I decide to change.

Title: To ruin an omega
Tags: Werewolf; Power Couple; Strong FL; Enemies to Lovers; Weak to Strong
Synopsis: Fia, an Omega from Silver Creek, never expected her blood to carry a secret powerful enough to shake the entire werewolf world. When she is drawn into Skollrend and bound to the cold, powerful Alpha Cian, buried memories begin to awaken—memories of forbidden experiments, ancient healer blood, and a woman named Athena whose past was erased from history. But the more Fia discovers about who she really is, the more dangerous she becomes to those who want to control her. Enemies are closing in. Allies are hiding secrets. And even Cian’s protection may become another kind of cage. Because Fia is not just the key to an ancient power. She may be the power everyone has been waiting for.

Title: Too Late to Beg_The Fat Heiress’s Revenge
Synopsis: Vivian secretly volunteered for an experimental drug trial to save her three adoptive brothers from a deadly family disease—gaining 130 pounds in the process. Now ridiculed as the “fat heiress” and shoved aside for the family’s newly returned biological sister Stella, Vivian endures humiliation in silence. But when Stella’s cruelty finally crosses the line, Vivian sheds her tears, her weight, and her loyalty—returning as the woman they will all regret losing.

Title: Too Late to Love Me—So He Went Back in Time
Tags: Power Couple; Strong FL; Hidden Feelings; Second Chance; Transmigration
Synopsis: After being publicly humiliated by the rich boy she loved, Sharon walks away for good. The night she moves out, a man identical to him blocks her door—he's Leo from three years in the future, consumed by regret, come back to rewrite her tragic fate. As he protects her, takes down his younger self, and exposes the sister who stole her art school dream, Sharon must decide: is this love, or just guilt wearing his face?

Title: Trapped as an NPC in a Dating Sim
Tags: Harem; Weak to Strong; Game Transmigration; Academy; System; Comedy
Synopsis: Soren was just a regular office worker — until he woke up inside the dating sim Lovers' Labyrinth as an inconsequential extra. But when a perverted harem system activates, he suddenly has a shot at something more. Armed with knowledge of the game's story, he completes deranged quests to level up, outmaneuvers the villain Kane before he can use demonic power to corrupt the academy's female students, and saves the Elise sisters from their tragic fate. Along the way, he stops the school from falling into ruin, and rises from a total nobody to elite hunter — with more than a few hearts caught in the process.

Title: Trapped by My Four Exes
Tags: Beloved by All; Reverse Harem; Strong FL; Revenge; Enemies to Lovers; Weak to Strong; Hidden Identity
Synopsis: A struggling fast-food worker with no memory of her past is suddenly confronted by a shocking truth: she was once a cold-blooded assassin who had four of the world's most powerful men wrapped around her finger.  After losing her memory in a car accident three years ago, Chloe has been living quietly in the slums, working long hours just to make ends meet. But one rainy night, her ordinary life comes to an abrupt end when four dangerous men corner her—the ruthless billionaire who was once her husband, a violent underground boxing champion, an obsessive genius doctor, and a legendary hacker with an overwhelming need for control.  They return carrying billion-dollar grudges and broken hearts, determined to make Chloe pay for the past. To them, she is the woman who deceived them, stole from them, and vanished without a trace.  Now, trapped between forgotten memories and old enemies, Chloe must uncover the truth about who she really was—before the four men who once loved and hated her.

Title: Trapped in the Summer Heat
Synopsis: When Marin’s five-year-old daughter is locked in a sweltering car, her husband Ryan ignores her desperate calls—too busy playing “daddy” to his mistress’s son. By the time Marin tears across the city to save her, Lily is barely breathing. Devastated and clear-eyed at last, Marin walks away from the marriage and rebuilds her life, only to find that the man who betrayed her—and the woman who stole him—are far from done with her.

Title: Troy's Revage
Synopsis: The protagonist, Troy Ewell, was hunted by enemies due to an accident five years ago, an event that unexpectedly altered the course of his life. Five years later, Troy returned to Vanson, determined to avenge the tragic deaths of his parents. Those who once looked down on him are destined to regret their past actions.

Title: True Love In Thorns
Synopsis: In an illegal auction, Jennie was found and saved by Jayden. To make Jennie atone for her father's sins, Jayden kept Jennie at his side. Yet soon, she was framed and hurt by all sorts of bad people. Luckily, Jayden was always there to save her!

Title: Tutor for the Quarterback
Tags: Enemies to Lovers; Young Adult; Campus; Sweet Love
Synopsis: Money-minded straight-A student Mia teams up with Chase, a star quarterback failing calculus and facing suspension. Their deal is simple: she helps him improve his grades, and he pretends to be her boyfriend.  Mia sets one strict rule—any physical contact costs extra.  But as tutoring turns into daily companionship, their fake relationship starts to feel real. Chase willingly “pays” for every step beyond the contract, while Mia begins to see the vulnerability behind his confident exterior.  What starts as a transaction slowly becomes genuine love—until their arrangement is exposed, forcing them to face whether their feelings were ever just part of the deal.

Title: Twisting Fate
Synopsis: Samara Lindley, grieving her late love Jeffrey's death three years ago in a car accident, discovers his heart was donated to Jason Hoggart. Overwhelmed by longing for Jeffrey, she assumes the identity of "Lin Shanshan" and appears by Jason Hoggart's side.

Title: Ugly Girl God of Cooking
Tags: Strong FL; Face-slapping; Sweet Love; Comedy
Synopsis: Supreme Sorceress Isabella Vance was struck by lightning during her heavenly tribulation, then her soul was mistakenly reaped by the God of Death and transported to another world. She became the bullied and despised ugly wife of the Sterling family. After rebirth, she possessed powerful magic and a sharp tongue. Yet she had no idea that the entire Sterling family could hear her inner thoughts! Isabella Vance crushes villains and gains wealth along the way. The cold CEO falls from disdain to deep infatuation and pursues her madly!

Title: Uncle Simon，Please Stop
Synopsis: To save her dying mother, Tessa agrees to an arranged marriage with the powerful Montgomery mafia family. But when she saves the life of Simon—a ruthless killer—everything changes. She soon discovers the horrifying truth: Simon isn't just the head of the Montgomery family. He's also her fiancé's uncle. Feared by everyone and driven by obsession, Simon will stop at nothing to make Tessa his. Torn between uncle and nephew, Tessa is drawn into a forbidden affair where desire is as dangerous as betrayal. One wrong move could cost her everything...

Title: Unexpected Love
Synopsis: Five years ago, Loren Ford was drugged and forced into a non-consensual encounter with Yelina Sullivan. After this, he fell in love with her. Five years later, Loren discovered Yelina was unhappy in her marriage and pursued her relentlessly, angering her husband, Simon Zane. Simon then...

Title: Unravelling the son-in-law
Synopsis: A young man goes down a mountain and goes through many hardships before meeting a beautiful CEO who insists on marrying him. Being the husband of a powerful woman is not easy. Should he do it?

Title: Unrivaled Path
Synopsis: Betrayed and broken, David Miller is saved by his first love, Isabella Shaw, and gains mystical powers. Seeking revenge and answers about his father's disappearance, he rises to power, uncovering a conspiracy that challenges everything he knows. Will his newfound strength be enough?

Title: Urban Dragon Might
Synopsis: After a cultivation backlash, Yang Yi descends to save his paralyzed fiancée Qin Yimo, betrayed and ruined. Healing her legs and rebuilding her company, he refuses Zhong Lingyun's sky-high offer, staying true. Once cured, she stands again — love unites them.

Title: Vendetta of the Deadly Beauty: Mansion Storm
Synopsis: Assassin Su Jiangxue, thrust into scorned daughterhood, defies odds after crossing realms. With her wit and medical skills, and supported by a wealthy fiancé, they seek revenge and build empires, leading to her becoming empress!

Title: Villain's Comeback
Synopsis: After transmigration into a novel, you become the miserable villain constantly humiliated by the hero. But if you follow the plot and finish your role, you can return to your world with a powerful system.

Title: Walker Love Tale
Synopsis: When a zombie outbreak hits, Mia saves someone—only to be attacked in return. Just when she’s about to die, Damian, the Zombie King who’s secretly loved her for years, comes to her rescue. Things get even crazier when Damian takes her home and his zombie parents already call her their daughter-in-law. Then Mia learns the cure may lie in Damian’s genes! Now she has one crazy plan: win over the Zombie King, have his baby, and save the world！

Title: Weak Fate: Thunder Rise
Synopsis: Evan, once the unparalleled prodigy of the magical realm, was labeled an F-rank useless healer during his Awakening Ceremony. Overnight, he was disowned by his clan, betrayed by his lover, and became the target of bullying across the entire academy. Trapped in utter despair, the long-dormant supreme Thunder Magic, a lost power long thought extinct within him, awakened silently. Yet he was framed as a dark mage, hunted by the whole school and opposed by the entire world. Caught between tender guardianship and brutal suppression by powerful forces, Evan tore through the darkness with his thunderous might, defeated the Ruler of Darkness, and reset the order of the world—forging a legendary destiny-defying tale from a worthless outcast to the Sovereign of Thunder.

Title: Web of Desire
Synopsis: A modern urban drama of family power struggles, love, and revenge, following Quinn Cole and the Sterling family through a tangled web of emotions and ambitions.

Title: werewolf Powers Stone
Synopsis: Damontry, a rare vampire‑werewolf hybrid and the last heir to a destroyed royal bloodline, disguises herself as a maid to infiltrate the enemy’s palace, reclaim her stolen heritage, and master her unstable powers while clashing with the ruthless royal family and hiding her dangerous true identity.

Title: What beauty costs
Synopsis: Gonzalo, a committed but unfaithful man tired of his long-term girlfriend, becomes irresistibly obsessed with Debora—a young, beautiful makeup artist who knows his secret, rejects his advances, and turns the tables on his womanizing games.

Title: When My Hated Mate Remembers
Tags: Werewolf; Strong FL; Rebirth; Love Triangle
Synopsis: After Alaric and I were bonded, the woman he loved, Caelia, took her own life.He hated me for it, and I was never one to back down.  The poison took hold after I drank a glass of water he handed me.So,  I plunged a silver dagger into his chest. But in my final moments, I heard him commanding his men to  save me and find the poisoner. When I was reborn, I immediately accepted  an overseas architecture project.I would leave, giving him the chance for a lifetime of peace with the one he truly loved.

Title: When My Husband Became My Father-in-Law
Tags: Werewolf; Forbidden Love; Age Gap; Royalty
Synopsis: "Prince Jacob of the werewolf clan and his father King Edward are cursed in the aftermath of a war, swapping their bodies. They are also stricken with an aphrodisiac poison that can only be cured by intimate union with Princess Evelyn. The witch delivers the remedy: Evelyn must choose one of them within seven days and attain genuine emotional fulfilment with her pick; otherwise, both men will perish, and the entire tribe will be destroyed. Trapped between her husband’s soul inhabiting the king’s body and her father-in-law’s soul trapped inside her husband’s form, Evelyn is plunged into an agonising dilemma. Further investigation reveals that Jacob orchestrated the curse from the very start in a bid to seize the throne. Crushed by this betrayal, Evelyn resolves to fight back. She allies with Edward to devise a counterplot, paying Jacob back in his own coin. Thus unfolds a werewolf conflict woven around power, betrayal and redemption."

Title: When the Moonrise Ceremony Fails
Tags: Werewolf; Playing Dumb; Love Triangle; Horror
Synopsis: My fated mate Kaelan wanted to please his mistress Briar, so he planned to let her act as Luna for a while. He pretended our bond was broken, refusing to even acknowledge me as his Luna. As I passed the gym, I heard Briar’s syrupy voice. "Darling, if I get to be Luna, will you mark me every night? But… won’t Selene be suspicious? You’ve been mates for seven years, after all." "What can she do?" Kaelan sneered. "She can’t leave the pack, and she certainly can’t leave me."

Title: Whispers From The WOMB OF LUNA
Synopsis: Elena, the eldest daughter of the Charles family, is shamed for being wolfless. Betrayed by her husband and tormented by her stepsister, she’s pushed to the brink. But her unborn baby is no ordinary child—he’s Thomas, the First Lycan King, reborn with a thousand years of memories. And when Lucius, the Lycan Progenitor and Elena’s fated mate, awakens, her fate begins to change. With them by her side, Elena turns the tables on everyone who wronged her.

Title: Wife's Temptation
Synopsis: Resentment in the wealthy households caused misunderstandings and wrong Love. Originally, Cherry was just a tool for Willis's revenge and venting. Unexpectedly, the one accompanying him was the true love he had been waiting for.

Title: Wolf Rule：Ember Reign
Synopsis: Reborn Loretta, armed with memories of her past life, chose a despised abandoned wolf cub instead of a mighty divine beast on the Spirit Beast Contract Day. When the contracted phoenix went berserk and ancient calamities awakened, this golden-maned wolf king that feeds on cosmic laws would ultimately forge its own golden dynasty atop the charred ruins of a dying world.

Title: Worthless to Priceless The Alpha's Rejected Mate
Synopsis: An unloved twin, betrayed by family and her only love. Hunted and abandoned, she flees to the dark ruthless Alpha King. Hidden power, deadly secrets, and a forbidden dark destiny. The outcast she-wolf becomes the queen of the night.

Title: Wounded Mercenary's Revenge
Synopsis: After revenging for his Green Dragon Squad protecting Stiala, Frost Cunningham, the once Lord War of Stiala, could no longer fight due to his serious wounds. So, he left the Army and came to Seasy City under his grandpa's instruction, planning to honor the engagement with Miss Spence. Yet the engagement was broken off.

Title: You'll Always Be Loved
Synopsis: In order to protect her loved one, Rosalie chooses to seek solace in the arms of another man. Five years later, her beloved returns with a vow to make her pay the price!

Title: 【English】Myriad Paths of the Dragon Emperor
Synopsis: Lu Ming, a young man with his Blood Energy forcibly taken, was reduced to a broken man, enduring untold humiliations. Fortunately, he acquired Ultimate Divinity Hall and the supreme Blood Energy. During this period, he took down numerous rivals and learned Fighting Dragon Technique, ascending to be Dragon King in the end.

Title: Craving My Stepbrother
Synopsis: Silas, the privileged heir of a powerful family, seems like an arrogant, rebellious straight alpha. In truth, he is desperately hiding his forbidden desire for his adoptive older brother, masking it with reckless behavior.    But Julian, the family's impeccably dressed Chief Risk Officer, saw through him long ago.    Behind the guise of ""disciplining"" his younger brother, Julian relentlessly corners Silas—leaving him nowhere to run. Silas resists, denies, and flees, yet every defense crumbles under Julian's control.    When his straight façade finally shatters and their secret relationship is exposed to the family, there is no turning back. In the cold silence of the family study, Silas makes his choice—grasping Julian's hand tightly in front of his furious father, refusing to let go.

Title: Dadbod
Synopsis: Pete King, a former baseball superstar struggling with his career and family, and his brilliant but isolated son Kevin have always misunderstood each other. After a magical body swap, Pete experiences the pressures of teenage life while Kevin takes on the challenges of being a professional athlete and team owner. Through this unexpected journey, they learn to understand each other and rebuild their broken relationship. DAD BOD is a heartfelt body-swap comedy about family, second chances, and seeing life from someone else’s perspective.

Title: Destroy the Husband Who Put Me in a Coma
Synopsis: On Valerie Sterling’s fifth wedding anniversary, her husband Christian Thorne pushed her off a skyscraper. She slipped into a three-year coma. Upon waking, she discovers Christian conspired with his mistress Amber Lin to kill her. He seized her shares, seized control of her company and lives lavishly with his lover. Valerie launches a cold-blooded revenge. Collecting audio evidence and gaining allies including loyal servant Martha, she brings the cruel couple crashing down. At last, Valerie revives the corporation and takes back everything that belongs to her.

Title: DO NOT OPEN
Synopsis: After moving to a mysterious town, Nora is warned never to open the door after 8 p.m.—but that very night, something terrifying happens.

Title: Dragon's vow
Synopsis: For centuries, female dragons were chained for the silver flame that could cleanse the Nether. Jenny Dragon, the last of them, spends ten years as Michael Shelby’s hidden cure, bleeding to keep Arthur Drake and Tom alive while losing her home, her dignity, and her son Leo’s trust. When Princess Ada turns that blood into a weapon, the pact breaks at midnight and Dragon King Arthur comes for Jenny. But rescue is only the beginning. To save Leo, the Dragon Tribe, and herself, Jenny must choose a vow freely given, before the Nether turns her love into its final gate.

Title: Fated To Not Just One, But Three
Tags: Werewolf; Reverse Harem; Revenge; Weak to Strong
Synopsis: Olivia was once a high-born Gamma, but after her father was framed for theft and executed, she was degraded to the lowest Omega tier and forced to become a maid to her former best friend, Anita. The three sons of the Pack Alpha—Lennox, Levi, and Louis—who were once her childhood close friends, turned their backs on her to revolve around Anita. At the Coming-of-Age Ceremony, Olivia unexpectedly manifests as the shared Fated Mate of all three brothers, dragging her into a whirlpool of power, lust, and betrayal. To clear her father’s name and protect her mother, Olivia leverages both love and hate, manipulating the brothers to turn against the true culprit.

Title: FROM SLUM FIGHTER TO MAFIA KING
Tags: Power Couple; Romance; Revenge; Face-slapping; Mafia
Synopsis: Arthur Arcadia is the unwanted son of a mafia heir, surviving brutal school bullying and underground fights to pay for his dying mother’s treatment. When the father who abandoned him suddenly returns, Arthur discovers the truth: he is only being used for a suicide mission—to infiltrate a deadly underground casino and steal a ledger capable of destroying the criminal empire. There, he meets Chloe Falcone, the godfather’s equally unwanted daughter. Together, two family outcasts fight their way through drug lords, betrayal, and bloodshed. Once treated as disposable pawns, they become the greatest threat to both families—and Arthur rises from forgotten bastard to the man who owns the empire.

Title: Legacy of the Wolf God
Tags: Inhuman MC; Abandoned; Weak to Strong; Evolution; Superpowers; Suspense
Synopsis: Grey, a wolf cub born unable to transform, is deemed a waste that must be eliminated by his tribe. After being exiled to the wasteland, he unexpectedly awakens the bloodline of the Wolf God who fell ten thousand years ago — devour everything to evolve! From a lowly black-furred pup to a celestial wolf form with golden horns and twin wings, his power skyrockets with every passing moment. However, the Blood Moon Council issues a new decree: any tribe with males of inferior bloodline shall be exterminated entirely. The once-abandoned outcast becomes the sole bargaining chip that will decide the life or death of his entire tribe.

Title: My beautiful wife - Test
Synopsis: 山村小神医给人治病，报酬竟是一个绝色美女老婆，苏晨这下发了！

Title: My Son Is the Zombie King
Synopsis: When the zombie virus swept the land, civilization fell.  They call him the king of the dead. His father calls him son.  The world wants him dead. His father wants him alive.  But Leo isn't just the cure — he's the weapon they can't control...

Title: My Uncle is Don Quixote
Tags: Adventure; Hidden Identity; System; Slice of Life
Synopsis: My name is Li Wei. After my parents passed away and left me with a huge debt, I was adopted by a distant uncle in the United States and went to New York to live with him.  Wait, what the hell is this Middle Ages Adventure System? It identifies my uncle as a mad Knight? The wealthy district of the Upper East Side is a Noble Courtyard? It looks like there's a succubus den up ahead, I've decided to go and explore it...  First day in New York, I abided by the law. Second day in New York, I tested the waters cautiously. Third day in New York, I decided I would protect the world. Fourth day in New York, I started to get tired of it. This world sucks. Fifth day in New York, am I the only Superman in this world?

Title: The Crown Was Never Hers
Synopsis: Abandoned by a prince, a maid swaps her baby with the queen's newborn. Eighteen years later, the true princess, raised in poverty, saves the queen without recognition. Falsely accused of theft and pushed to attempt suicide, she discovers her heritage. The queen, slowly poisoned by her unfaithful husband and the fake daughter, learns the truth. At the coronation, she dramatically reveals the conspiracy and publicly embraces her real daughter.

Title: The Great Jiang Dragon Clan
Synopsis: At the Jiang Dragon Clan’s bloodline awakening ceremony, Young Lord Jiang Shenwu awakens only an eight-zhang Common Dragon. Scorned and rejected by his entire clan, he is ordered to rank among the top ten at the Demon Slaying Meet within three days—or be expelled from Prince Zong Mansion. Meanwhile, his uncle Jiang Rong has embezzled the resources left behind by Jiang Shenwu’s father, Dragon Lord Jiang Zizai, and is secretly plotting to seize the title of Dragon Lord. Yet what Jiang Shenwu has truly awakened is the extraordinary bloodline of the Ancient Devouring Black Dragon. With the power to devour without limit, Jiang Shenwu crushes conspiracies and consumes powerful enemies along the way. His meteoric rise attracts the attention of a gifted young lady from the Imperial City. He sweeps through the Jiang Clan, conquers Secret Realms, storms the Imperial City, finds his master’s father, and ultimately challenges the Dragon Emperor himself!

Title: Uncle's Forbidden Rules
Synopsis: Arthur Russell, Wall Street's most ruthless financial titan, was once the closest friend of Seraphine's late father. To the world, he is the loyal guardian protecting his fallen friend's daughter. But behind absolute power, that paternal façade has long since shattered.    At eighteen, Seraphine doesn't run from the man who is both father figure and untouchable idol. Fully aware of the forbidden line she is crossing, she willingly surrenders her freedom in exchange for the tyrant's most dangerous devotion.    When their taboo relationship ignites a Wall Street scandal, Arthur refuses to yield. Crushing every judgment with the force of his empire, he claims her before the world. By day, she is the respected Mrs. Russell. By night, she belongs to him—and him alone.
